### О Мэй Маск

Мэй Маск — автор мировых бестселлеров, диетолог, супермодель и спикер. В 69 лет она стала самой возрастной моделью Covergirl, а сегодня, в 75+, является амбассадором Dior Beauty. Ее достижения в модельном бизнесе уступают только ее 50-летней успешной карьере предпринимателя и диетолога.

Всего за несколько десятилетий Мэй создала настоящую империю в области питания, охватив своей деятельностью восемь городов и три страны, постоянно выступая, консультируя, издавая книги и публикуясь в СМИ.

Она достигла впечатляющего профессионального роста сразу в трех странах: стала первым представителем Ассоциации консультирующих диетологов Южной Африки, президентом Ассоциации консультирующих диетологов Канады и председателем предпринимательского отделения Академия питания и диетологии США.

В наши дни Мэй продолжает делиться своим уникальным опытом в темах предпринимательства, старения, равенства, воспитания, уверенности в себе и здоровья на самых известных площадках и в самых прогрессивных компаниях мира. А теперь это доступно и вам — в ее первом квесте для платформы Mindvalley.

Als Mindvalley-Mitglied erhältst du Zugang zu außergewöhnlicher Transformation für jeden Bereich deines Lebens.

Schalte nicht nur das volle Potenzial deines Geistes und deiner Seele frei, sondern verbessere auch deine Karriere, dein finanzielle Situation, deine Gesundheit und deine Beziehungen mit Mindvalleys vollständigem Lehrplan mit erstklassigen Programmen. Außerdem enthalten:

*   Die besten Lehrer der Welt.
*   Modernste Lernmethoden und Technologien.
*   Und die weltweit leidenschaftlichste Community von Gleichgesinnten.

Die Mindvalley Membership bietet dir alles, was du brauchst, um dein volles Potential zu entdecken und jeden Tag nach deinen höchsten Ambitionen zu greifen.

### Das ist in deiner Mindvalley Membership enthalten:

Die Mindvalley Kurssammlung

40 Kurse auf Deutsch für alle Bereiche deines Lebens

Mindvalley Live

Live-Webinare mit den besten Mentor/innen der Welt (auf Englisch verfügbar)

Personalisierte Lernreisen

Tauche ein in handverlesene Programme für Körper, Herz und Beruf.

Mindvalley Connections-App

Ein privates soziales Netzwerk mit Events und Meet-Ups

### Erfahrungsberichte mit der Mindvalley Membership

[](https://stories.mindvalley.com/product/mindvalley-membership)

### [Ich fühle mich selbstbewusst, entspannt und voller Liebe für mein Leben](https://www.mindvalley.com/de/membership/promo/promo-es)

Meine drei wichtigsten Erkenntnisse sind die Entwicklung von psychischen Fähigkeiten, die Stärkung meiner Intuition und die Bereitschaft, wirklich große Träume zu träumen. [mehr lesen](https://stories.mindvalley.com/product/mindvalley-membership)

Head of Design, Vai Kai

Berlin, Germany

Vishen ist so eine liebenswerte Person, und das sind auch die anderen. Froh und dankbar, hier unter so inspirierenden Menschen zu sein. [mehr lesen](https://stories.mindvalley.com/product/mindvalley-membership)

Austria

[](https://stories.mindvalley.com/product/mindvalley-membership)

Ich begann meine Reise damit, mich freiwillig für NGOs zu engagieren, 20 Stunden am Tag zu arbeiten und keine Zeit zu haben, meine Eltern zu besuchen. Ich sagte mir, dass ich die Welt verändern würde, meine Familie kann warten. An dem Tag, als ich meine Mutter verlor, sah ich, dass sie... [mehr lesen](https://stories.mindvalley.com/product/mindvalley-membership)

Elif Hurdogan

Germany

Director Tea or Coffee School of English

Barcelona, Spain

##### Risikofrei: 15 Tage Probezeit

Beachte, dass du nicht sofort JA sagen musst. Ein VIELLEICHT reicht. Sieh dir die Quest-Inhalte für 15 Tage nach Kauf risikofrei an.

Du kannst dir den Preis selbst jederzeit mit nur einem Klick zurückerstatten. Keine Emails, Anrufe oder anderer Stress nötig. Begib dich einfach zu unserer [Rückerstattungsseite](https://www.mindvalley.com/de/refund)
 und erhalte schnell deine komplette Erstattung. Ohne Fragen.

Werde Mindvalley Mitglied, um zu starten

![Mindvalley Quest All Access on various devices](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1728x900/4fd20c8f7f/maa_sp_devices_jointheprogram_de.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=1&width=800)

Was du bekommst:

*   Unbegrenzten Zugriff auf die gesamte Mindvalley-Kollektion mit mehr als  
    **40 transformierenden Kursen auf Deutsch** (sowie 100+ auf Englisch)
*   Zugriff auf alle zukünftigen Kurse
*   Voller Zugriff auf alle Online-Communities für alle Mindvalley-Kurse
*   Eine bedingungslose 15-tägige Geld-zurück-Garantie
*   Smartphone-App (Apple oder Android) zum Lernen für unterwegs
*   Desktop-Version, iPad-App und Apple TV
*   **Plus: einen einmaligen Preis, der nur auf dieser Seite erhältlich ist**

##### Zwei Möglichkeiten, wie du dazukommen kannst

Bester Preis

#### Mira una muestra de la Masterclass

#### Lo que aprenderás:

1.  La clave de la dicha incondicional, sin importar qué suceda a tu alrededor
    
    La dicha no es un regalo temporal que aparece y desaparece dependiendo de tus circunstancias: es un estado permanente que eliges en cada momento de tu vida. Descubre cómo.
    
2.  Cómo eliminar para siempre el sufrimiento de tu vida
    
    ¿El sufrimiento es un resultado inevitable del dolor que enfrentas en la vida? De acuerdo con Sadhguru, no tiene que ser así: con la perspectiva correcta puedes decidir no volver a sufrir ni un solo instante.
    
3.  ¿Por qué conceptos como "moralidad" y "dogma religioso" sabotean tu crecimiento espiritual?
    
    De acuerdo con Sadhguru, cuando buscas lo que es correcto para ti, hay una sola brújula que debes seguir, pero no la encontrarás en ningún texto religioso o filosófico.
    
4.  El poder de la jovialidad en un mundo lleno de dolor
    
    Muchas personas pierden la jovialidad y el entusiasmo de la infancia, con lo cual también pierden uno de los aspectos más profundos de la experiencia humana. Descubre cómo recuperarlos a cualquier edad.
    
5.  Qué hacer cuando te sientes agobiado por el estrés y la ansiedad
    
    Sadhguru dice que al trabajar con tu química interior no solo reducirás el estrés y la ansiedad, sino que los borrarás completamente de tu realidad.
    
6.  Y mucho más.

Saldrás de esta Masterclass con nuevas herramientas y perspectivas para gestionar tus emociones y experiencias diarias, para superar el dolor y el sufrimiento, y para llenar cada momento de tu vida con una profunda sensación de dicha, paz y conexión con todo y con todos a tu alrededor.

### Acerca de Sadhguru

Sadhguru es un admirado yogui y visionario. Se le considera una de las 50 personas más influyentes de la India y su labor ha influido en la vida de millones de personas en todo el mundo por medio de sus programas de transformación.

Sadhguru tiene una habilidad única para hacer que las antiguas ciencias del yoga sean relevantes para la mente contemporánea. Su enfoque no se adscribe a ningún sistema de creencias, pero ofrece métodos poderosos y comprobados para la autotransformación.

Sadhguru, orador de renombre internacional y autor del éxito de ventas del New York Times _Ingeniería interior: guía yogui para la alegría y el gozo_, ha sido una voz influyente en los principales foros mundiales, incluyendo las Naciones Unidas y el Foro Económico Mundial, donde ha abordado temas tan diversos como el desarrollo socioeconómico, el liderazgo y la espiritualidad.

También lo han invitado a hablar en destacadas instituciones educativas como Oxford, la Escuela de Negocios de Londres, el IMD, Stanford, Harvard, Yale, Wharton y el MIT.

En febrero de 2017, Sadhguru recibió el premio Padma Vibhushan del Gobierno de India, la condecoración civil anual más importante de ese país, que reconoce el servicio excepcional y destacado de alguna persona. En su primera Masterclass de Mindvalley, Sadhguru impartirá su sabiduría acerca de una amplia gama de filosofías que te llevarán a alcanzar la dicha incondicional, el dominio personal y una profunda paz, tanto interior como exterior.

### La Chiave Sta in Questo Sistema a 4 Livelli dell’Evoluzione della Consapevolezza

![Four Levels of Human Consciousness](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1280x720/d74836804d/sp_solution_landscape_it.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Ogni persona sul pianeta agisce in uno di questi livelli della consapevolezza umana, il che influenza il modo di percepire e vivere la sua vita e, a sua volta, la capacità personale di successo, affermazione, realizzazione, pace e connessione.

La maggior parte di noi passa tutta la vita in uno dei livelli più bassi, anche se è davvero possibile elevarsi a quelli più alti, a condizione che si seguano i passi giusti.

È qui che entra in gioco il programma Realtà Straordinaria. Prima ti aiuta a scoprire in quale livello ti trovi, poi ti dà gli strumenti e le conoscenze per elevarti.

Ecco una spiegazione più dettagliata di ogni livello:

**LIVELLO 1**: Il 75% della popolazione del pianeta agisce da questo livello. In questo livello, siamo condizionati dalla società, dalla cultura e dal sistema educativo. Qui, la maggior parte delle persone brancola nel buio. Siamo condizionati da idee come “ti serve una laurea” o “devi trovarti un lavoro e mettere i soldi da parte per la pensione”.

Quando metti in discussione questi modelli della società umana, ecco che inizi ad elevarti al livello 2.

**LIVELLO 2**: Il livello 2 è la fase in cui i “Pensieri creano la realtà”. Qui è dove comincia la crescita personale. In questo livello cominci ad esplorare nuovi modi di presentarti al mondo. È dove scopri idee come la meditazione, l’apprendimento rapido, la trasformazione personale e i segreti della forma fisica. È il momento in cui inizi a elevarti oltre a ciò che la maggior parte della gente fa, per creare la tua Realtà Straordinaria.

Ma c’è ancora molta strada da fare per raggiungere il livello più alto.

**LIVELLO 3**: Il livello 3 è l'obiettivo di Realtà Straordinaria. Arrivi al livello 3 quando metti in discussione così tante idee del mondo tradizionale, da metterti “al servizio di una vocazione più alta”.

A questo livello, iniziano a sorgere in te capacità del tutto nuove, come la sensazione di connessione con l’umanità e con l’esistenza. La sensazione di connessione con il tuo essere. La sensazione di una creazione cosciente e accelerata, in cui hai la sensazione che i tuoi pensieri si concretizzino a un ritmo accelerato. E infine, senti che la fortuna è dalla tua parte, come se l’universo stesse lavorando per te.

**LIVELLO 4**: Questo è un livello di rara e mistica unità con il Mondo. Scoprirai di più su questo livello e sulle persone che lo hanno raggiunto, all’interno della Quest. Tuttavia, la maggior parte del programma Realtà Straordinaria si concentra sul Livello 3, dove ti aspettano i vantaggi più concreti e raggiungibili.

### Vishen Lakhiani, Creatore di Realtà Straordinaria

Vishen Lakhiani è il **fondatore di Mindvalley**, un vero e proprio movimento educativo, pluripremiato, con milioni di studenti in tutto il mondo – sempre in aumento. Con Mindvalley, Vishen ha trascorso più di **15 anni** a ripensare all’esperienza umana – per esplorare la scienza di aiutare gli esseri umani a raggiungere il loro massimo potenziale.

In qualità di Fondatore di Mindvalley, Vishen ha creato le Mindvalley Quest, l’evento A-Fest, la Mindvalley University, e le piattaforme tecnologiche Mindvalley, per aiutare a plasmare milioni di vite attraverso la trasformazione personale. **Ha portato Mindvalley ad entrare fra le aziende “Fortune 500” in America** e a tenere dei **training** per loro e per milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, per permettere loro di vivere vite straordinarie. Il contributo di Vishen nella crescita personale si estende anche al settore pubblico, in qualità di **relatore a conferenze**, lavorando per far evolvere i sistemi centrali che influenzano la nostra vita – tra cui l’istruzione, la cultura del lavoro, la politica e il benessere.

Vishen è anche **l’autore del best seller del New York Times**, _Il Codice della Mente Straordinaria_ (tradotto in più di 25 lingue), dove insegna a pensare come alcune delle più grandi menti anticonformiste della nostra epoca, a mettere in discussione, a sfidare, hackerare e a creare nuove regole per la TUA vita, con cui poter definire il tuo successo, alle tue condizioni.

La Quest _Realtà Straordinaria_ racchiude decenni di studio condotti da Vishen in campi quali la crescita personale, la consapevolezza umana, la spiritualità moderna e l’apprendimento trasformazionale, cosicché tutti possano beneficiare del sistema dell’evoluzione della consapevolezza, che ha aiutato Vishen, e decine di migliaia di persone in tutto il mondo, a costruirsi una vita fuori dall’ordinario, una realtà straordinaria.

![Portrait of Vishen Lakhiani](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/700x760/791ded4431/be_sp_author-m.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

![Portrait of Vishen Lakhiani](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1200x1300/03b7022460/be_sp_author-d_s.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Credenziali del Docente

*   Vishen Lakhiani è il fondatore di Mindvalley, un movimento educativo globale, pluripremiato, con oltre 12 milioni di studenti in tutto il mondo.
    
*   Autore di 2 Best Seller del New York Times, "Il codice della mente straordinaria", tradotto in 25+ lingue, e "Il Buddha e lo Sfrontato".
    
*   Inventore di numerose tecniche e piattaforme per la crescita personale – inclusa la Meditazione in 6 Fasi, l'App Omvana, l'evento A-Fest, e le Mindvalley Quest.
    
*   Gli insegnamenti di Vishen sulla mente, vengono applicati con successo dagli atleti nelle più importanti competizioni sportive americane, comprese l'NBA, la NFL e il Campionato di Tennis US Open.
    

![Vishen Lakhiani](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1000x560/93277d569d/be_sp_reality-infusion-1_2x.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Vishen ha trascorso più di 25 anni sperimentando strumenti e tecniche per spianare la strada all’evoluzione della consapevolezza.

![Vishen Lakhiani](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1000x560/7813654166/be_sp_reality-infusion-2_2x.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Vishen è stato invitato a parlare in aziende come Facebook e Google. È stato anche ospite dell’ONU.

Contenuti del Programma
-----------------------

### Esplora i contenuti della Quest Realtà Straordinaria

La Quest Realtà Straordinaria ti porta in un viaggio di 30 giorni, facile da seguire, ti guida attraverso ogni fase per arrivare alla Fase 3 della consapevolezza: dove potrai sbloccare livelli elevatissimi di auto-controllo, obiettivi, prestazioni e connessione.

Durante la Quest andrai a fondo nei tuoi sistemi di vita e nei tuoi modelli di realtà. Vedrai i tuoi schemi mentali e le tue credenze sotto una luce completamente nuova. Acquisirai 18 abilità da usare subito per ‘aggiornare’ la tua programmazione interna così da trasformare per sempre il tuo modo di pensare, di agire e di mostrarti al mondo.

Alla fine del percorso, avrai ottenuto gli strumenti e le intuizioni che ti servono per innalzare il tuo livello di consapevolezza. Potrai finalmente portare la tua crescita personale al massimo livello.

La prima è migliorando sul tuo hardware: l’insieme di credenze che la società ti ha “installato” in merito a tutto: dal lavoro, ai soldi, l’amore, l’invecchiamento… Scoprirai quante volte ti limita quell’‘hardware che ti hanno installato.

La seconda è aggiornando il tuo software: l’insieme di pratiche quotidiane e di sistemi di vita che ti dicono come passare il tempo e come organizzare la tua giornata. Con il software giusto, puoi acquisire il pieno controllo della tua vita, fare molto di più e sentirti meglio nel farlo.

Studiando l’Ingegneria della Consapevolezza come riscaldamento per Realtà Straordinaria, otterrai risultati di gran lunga migliori, motivo per cui ti offriamo questo programma gratuitamente.

La Meditazione in Sei Fasi

Basata sulla sintesi di centinaia di libri sulla crescita personale e sui più recenti studi scientifici, la Meditazione in 6 fasi è la formula personale di Vishen per sbloccare i benefici trasformazionali della meditazione, in soli 7 giorni.

Che tu pratichi la meditazione da sempre o che tu abbia appena cominciato, il Programma si adatterà al tuo livello e ti guiderà verso un risveglio straordinario della tua mente, del corpo e dello spirito, attraverso una delle pratiche di crescita personale più amate al mondo.

**La Quest Meditazione in 6 fasi** è la compagna perfetta del corso Realtà Straordinaria, in quanto ti offre un ulteriore strumento per superare i tuoi limiti percepiti e sperimentare l’intero ventaglio di possibilità della tua natura illimitata.

### Risveglia la persona di successo che è in te

Il programma La Tua Vita Senza Compromessi ha lo scopo di guidarti attraverso l'acclamato procedimento di Ipnoterapia Trasformazionale di Marisa Peer, per creare un cambiamento profondo e duraturo nella tua programmazione interiore e nella tua vita.

Come dimostrano numerosi studi scientifici, la pratica dell'Ipnoterapia Trasformazionale riprogramma letteralmente il tuo cervello per ottenerne il massimo rendimento - e si è persino dimostrata efficace nel trattamento della depressione, nella gestione del dolore e dello stress e molto altro ancora.

Durante il percorso, la tua struttura neurologica subirà una profonda trasformazione - facendoti pensare, sentire e percepire ad un livello completamente nuovo.

Le tue paure, le tue dipendenze e le tue ansie svaniranno. Comincerai a raggiungere i tuoi obiettivi con più facilità - sia che si tratti di guadagnare uno stipendio straordinario, di brillare nella tua attività o carriera, o di eccellere nelle tue relazioni personali.

### Marisa Peer, creatrice della tecnica dell'Ipnoterapia Trasformazionale

Marisa Peer è la terapeuta numero 1 del Regno Unito, secondo la rivista Tatler. Negli ultimi 25 anni, è stata la terapeuta di un'ampia lista di clienti, tra cui reali, rockstar, celebrità di Hollywood, atleti olimpici, leader politici e manager di aziende multimiliardarie.

La tecnica di Marisa è conosciuta come Ipnoterapia Trasformazionale (Rapid Transformational Therapy®): una scienza dell'ottimizzazione mentale che trasforma completamente il tuo modo di pensare e di vivere, spesso in solo una o due sedute. Attraverso il suo lavoro, Marisa ha scoperto che esistono otto modelli di pensiero che solo il top 1% delle persone di maggior successo nel mondo possiede, ma che chiunque, di quel restante 99%, può imparare e adottare per creare una vita di un successo straordinario. Dal 2015, Marisa ha contribuito a instillare questi modelli mentali nella mente di oltre 100.000 membri di Mindvalley, attraverso le sue famose sedute di Ipnoterapia Trasformazionale.

Sia durante le sue popolari Masterclass, che durante le sue numerose partecipazioni a eventi come A-Fest, Mindvalley Reunion e Mindvalley U, le sessioni rivoluzionarie di Marisa ricevono sempre il voto più alto dai suoi entusiasti partecipanti.

Il corso La Tua Vita senza Compromessi è un'ottima opportunità per sperimentare la sua tecnica di Ipnoterapia Trasformazionale e rimuovere gli ostacoli alla tua piena realizzazione come persona di successo.

![Marisa Peer](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/700x760/a540ccde06/ul_sp_author-m.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=1&width=auto)

![Marisa Peer](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1200x1720/eb4a956cd3/ul_sp_author-d__max_height_.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=1&width=600)

Credenziali della docente

*   Ampiamente considerata la principale speaker motivazionale del Regno Unito; spesso riceve un grado di approvazione del 100% dal suo pubblico.
*   Il rivoluzionario approccio di Marisa all'ipnoterapia le ha fatto vincere numerosi premi, tra cui otto Stevie Awards e un Venus award.
*   Regolarmente presente nei programmi televisivi di tutto il mondo e nel Regno Unito: tra cui BBC News, Sky News, ITV News, Channel 4 News e molti altri ancora.
*   Descritta come "grande pioniera britannica" dalla rivista Men's Health e inclusa nella guida del Tatler dei 250 Migliori Medici Britannici.

![Marisa ha recentemente vinto diversi Stevie Awards, tra cui il Premio Donna dell'Anno, Imprenditrice dell'Anno e il Premio alla Carriera.](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1000x560/ffcaed25cb/ul_sp_reality-infusion-2.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=1&width=486)

Marisa ha recentemente vinto diversi Stevie Awards, tra cui il Premio Donna dell'Anno, Imprenditrice dell'Anno e il Premio alla Carriera.

![Marisa mentre guida un pubblico di 800 persone attraverso incredibili trasformazioni.](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1000x560/34d3b5e406/ul_sp_reality-infusion-1.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=1&width=486)

Marisa mentre guida un pubblico di 800 persone attraverso incredibili trasformazioni.

Contenuti del Programma
-----------------------

### Esplora i contenuti di La Tua Vita Senza Compromessi

Il corso La Tua Vita Senza Compromessi consiste in un'immersione profonda di 8 settimane nella tua mente e nei modelli di pensiero e di percezione della realtà che danno forma alla tua vita. Ogni settimana, ti unirai a Marisa Peer in una serie di sedute interattive di Ipnoterapia Trasformazionale - una per ciascuno degli otto cambiamenti mentali. Otterrai e prenderai parte a tutorial, esercizi di ipnosi e sessioni di domande e risposte, per sbloccare il tuo massimo potenziale. Ognuna di queste trasformazioni provocherà una svolta in diverse aree della tua vita, come la fiducia in te stesso, l'autostima, le prestazioni di carriera, le relazioni, la sicurezza in te stesso, l'etica del lavoro e altro ancora: tutti trampolini di lancio verso la tua vita senza compromessi. È un'esperienza liberatoria, che sarà in grado di espandere la tua mente in meno di due ore alla settimana. Finalmente aprirai gli occhi e potrai raggiungere il tuo vero potenziale.

![Disponibile sul tuo PC, Tablet, Smartphone e Apple TV](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/2068x1110/097d4ce48a/ul_sp_devices_curriculum_it.png?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=1&width=800)

Come sappiamo, la mente ha molteplici strati di profondità. In questa prima settimana, esplorerai ognuno di questi, mentre Marisa sovrascriverà sui paradigmi obsoleti e nocivi degli strati più profondi della tua mente nuovi modelli di potenziamento che si allineino perfettamente ai tuoi obiettivi e desideri.

**Riacquista la tua autostima**

Scopri i due trucchi per ottenere un potente controllo mentale e impara ad usarli per trasformare l'immagine che hai di te stesso e la tua autostima. Entro la fine di questa settimana, avrai un atteggiamento incrollabile che ti aiuterà ad eliminare le distrazioni e a concentrarti sulle tue priorità.

**Rendi familiare ciò che è estraneo**

Troppe persone sono bloccate in una zona di comfort di mediocrità e familiarità, evitando l'ignoto per paura di fallire o di cambiare. In questa settimana, Marisa cambierà questi modelli in modo che tu sia sempre entusiasta di esplorare, crescere e sfidare te stesso, proprio come una persona di successo.

We spend the prime years of our lives preparing for our careers. But we spend hardly any time preparing for things that will determine the quality of our life experience and the quality of our relationships, health, mindset and wellbeing. Mindvalley teaches you the things that actually matter most in life.

And we do it by bringing in the latest cutting edge techniques, the world’s best teachers, and a powerful learning platform that is the best of its kind in the world.

“We’re constantly exploring, inventing, and optimizing personal transformation to ultimately unite our species, save our planet, and usher in a new golden age for humanity.”

\- Vishen Lakhiani, Founder of Mindvalley

![A big group of people hugging each other on the stage of Mindvalley University](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/fetch/c_scale,dpr_1,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,w_584/https://static.mindvalley.com/public/assets/2019/08/wAk8_mv-about-feature-big-1.jpg)

### At Mindvalley, learning is a lifelong adventure

The Mindvalley curriculum is designed to unleash the fullest potential of your mind, body, and spirit. It’s about being a rockstar at work. Having a healthy, youthful, energetic body. Experiencing unbreakable joy, love, and fulfillment. Connecting deeply with the people and communities around you. And contributing your unique gifts to the planet.

But beyond the tangible, there’s also something else going on beneath Mindvalley’s surface…

### Our teachers and students tell us there’s a certain magic in everything we do

A sense of fun, joy, friendship, and authenticity. Some have come to call this the ‘Mindvalley Effect’ – and we’d like to think it’s a big reason why many of the world’s greatest teachers, from Ken Wilber to Robin Sharma to Neale Donald Walsch, choose to publish their work on our learning platforms. And why many people consider Mindvalley not just a company or a movement – but a way of life.

![3 friends enjoying a night out](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/fetch/c_scale,dpr_1,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,w_584/https://static.mindvalley.com/public/assets/2019/08/WJmv_mv-about-feature-big-2.jpg)

20 mil

Students  
worldwide

5x

More likely to complete our courses

200+

Authors, speakers and activists

The Mindvalley Difference
-------------------------

### 5X Better Completion Rates than Traditional Online Learning\*

Our content and courses have radically transformed the way we consume information and learn. It’s not just something we say. It’s something we do. Our Quest platform has an \*333% better completion rate than industry average. These deep-dives into personal transformation use scientifically proven motivators and systems that help you make life changes that really stick.

![Hand holding a phone showing the screen of the Mindvalley Quest](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/fetch/c_scale,dpr_1,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,w_379/https://static.mindvalley.com/public/assets/2019/08/jb3V_mv-about-content-1.jpg)

Daily Bite-Size Micro-Learnings

Our scientifically-backed tools and technology make complicated topics easy to understand and integrate for results.

![Group photo of Mindvalley Authors](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/fetch/c_scale,dpr_1,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,w_379/https://static.mindvalley.com/public/assets/2019/08/tiB5_mv-about-content-2.jpg)

The Best Authors, Speakers And Activists

Our experts are living legends; best-selling authors and brilliant minds who know how to inspire and transform.

![Two people hugging each other](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/fetch/c_scale,dpr_1,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,w_379/https://static.mindvalley.com/public/assets/2019/08/iTcy_mv-about-content-3.jpg)

Group Motivation: Start and End Together

Community is the key to ultimate growth. Connect and grow with other members and be inspired by their journeys.

The Mindvalley Team
-------------------

### Surround Yourself with People Who Inspire You

Mindvalley is home to hundreds of incredibly talented educators, employees, and tribe members like you who have dedicated their lives to helping themselves and others achieve the ultimate in personal transformation.

![The Mindvalley Team Members](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/fetch/c_scale,dpr_1,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,w_1000/https://static.mindvalley.com/public/assets/2019/08/oVwE_mv-about-group.jpg)

[Meet The Mindvalley Team](https://www.mindvalley.com/about/team?itm_source=mv.com&itm_medium=mv_about&itm_campaign=mv_about_team)

Meet Vishen Lakhiani
--------------------

![Vishen Lakhiani's Portrait](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/fetch/c_scale,dpr_1,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,w_381/https://static.mindvalley.com/public/assets/2019/09/UJTV_mv-about-vishen.jpg)

Vishen Lakhiani was a computer engineer and senior leader at a rapidly growing Silicon Valley startup. But he faced extreme stress and was burnt out. He took up meditation as a solution and it completely changed his life. He quit the valley to study meditation, teach around the world and go into deep mastery of human development. Mindvalley was born as a result. Today Vishen is on a quest to remake how the world works in terms of business, politics, education and spirituality.

[Get To Know Vishen](https://www.vishen.com/?itm_source=mv.com&itm_medium=mv_about&itm_campaign=vishen_homepage)

### What does Mindvalley do?

Mindvalley is an online learning platform dedicated to personal growth and self-improvement. We offer a wide range of programs (called Quests) through the Mindvalley Membership, as well as specialized degrees and coaching certifications (Academy). All of our programs are taught by world-renowned experts in areas like mindfulness, health, fitness, relationships, and entrepreneurship. Our mission is to empower individuals to live healthier, happier, and more fulfilling lives by providing transformative education that goes beyond traditional schooling. Essentially, what is Mindvalley? It's your guide to unlocking your fullest human potential.

### Is Mindvalley credible?

Yes, Mindvalley is widely considered a credible and reputable platform for personal growth and education. Founded by Vishen Lakhiani, Mindvalley collaborates with leading experts and thought leaders in various fields to create high-quality courses and programs. They focus on transformative learning experiences, offering content on topics like mindfulness, health, entrepreneurship, and relationships. Our credibility is supported by a large global community, 24,000+ positive user testimonials, and a commitment to evidence-based practices in their curriculum design. While individual results may vary, Mindvalley's consistent delivery of valuable content reinforces its standing as a trusted resource.

### How much does Mindvalley cost?

Mindvalley offers a few subscription options to access its wide range of programs and courses. The most popular choice is the annual Mindvalley Membership, which gives you unlimited access to nearly all our Quests and programs for a single yearly fee. We also offer monthly payment plans and lifetime memberships, though these can vary in availability. For the most current and specific pricing details, including any special offers, it's best to visit the official Mindvalley website directly.

### What is the story behind Mindvalley?

Mindvalley was founded by Vishen Lakhiani in 2003 with a vision to revolutionize education and personal growth. Starting from a small home office, Vishen aimed to create a platform that offered transformative learning experiences beyond traditional schooling. The company's origins are deeply rooted in the belief that everyone deserves access to world-class teachings for mind, body, and spirit. Over the years, Mindvalley has grown into a global phenomenon, curating programs from leading experts to help millions unlock their full potential and live extraordinary lives.

### What is the Mindvalley app?

The Mindvalley app is a powerful self-improvement platform offering a wide range of personal growth programs, known as Quests. Developed by Mindvalley, the app provides access to expert-led courses on topics like mindfulness, productivity, health, and relationships. It's designed to help users unlock their full potential and live more fulfilling lives through engaging daily lessons, meditations, and exercises, all conveniently accessible from your mobile device.

### Who is CEO of Mindvalley?

The CEO of Mindvalley is Vishen Lakhiani. He is also the founder of the company. Vishen started Mindvalley with a vision to revolutionize education and help individuals unlock their full potential through personal growth and transformation. Under his leadership, Mindvalley has grown into a global learning platform offering programs in various areas like mindfulness, entrepreneurship, and health.

### What is Mindvalley's main focus?

Mindvalley's main focus is on transforming lives through personal growth and lifelong learning. Our mission is to provide world-class education in areas like mindfulness, health, business, and relationships. We aim to empower individuals to unlock their full potential and live more fulfilling lives by offering courses and programs taught by leading experts. Essentially, Mindvalley is dedicated to helping people become the best versions of themselves across all aspects of life.

#### Смотрите трейлер мастер-класса

#### Что вы узнаете

1.  Есть ли у вас 7 вредных убеждений о деньгах?
    
    Вы пройдете экспресс-тест и узнаете, от каких убеждений о деньгах вам нужно избавиться уже сегодня, чтобы сразу же повысить свой уровень достатка.
    
2.  Три неожиданные идеи, в которые верят миллионеры, добившиеся всего самостоятельно.
    
    Опросив 12 000 миллионеров, Кен выявил три фактора их успеха, которые оказались весьма неожиданными.
    
3.  Как добиться баланса между денежным IQ и денежным EQ.
    
    Вы узнаете, от чего зависит богатство в долгосрочной перспективе и почему даже умнейшие люди теряют деньги так же быстро, как и зарабатывают.
    
4.  Не завладел ли вашими финансами «денежный монстр».
    
    Вы сможете исцелиться от одной из главных финансовых травм, вызывающей безотчетный страх перед деньгами. Возможно, именно эта модель мышления не позволяет вам достаточно зарабатывать и даже погружает вас в долги.
    
5.  Почему только лишь рост заработка никогда не сделает вас богатым.
    
    Вы научитесь мыслить в стиле «изобилие по запросу», и в вашу жизнь очень быстро войдет богатство, процветание и финансовая безопасность.
    
6.  Как подняться на третий уровень финансового восприятия.
    
    Вы узнаете, как радикально изменить свое финансовое мышление, чтобы практически начать «дышать» деньгами.
    
7.  Как определить свой тип денежного EQ.
    
    У каждого из нас в сознании скрыты детские воспоминания – «денежные страшилки», которые управляют нашими отношениями с деньгами, – часто с катастрофическими последствиями. Вы определите, какие «денежные страшилки» вас пугают и как избавиться от них навсегда.
    
8.  Технику благодарности деньгам «Аригато».
    
    Вы научитесь секретной технике, при помощи которой один из богатейших людей Японии Вахей Такеда в корне изменил свои отношения с деньгами и вошел в историю как «японский Уоррен»
    

И многое другое!

### О Кене Хонде

Кен Хонда – самый узнаваемый и влиятельный наставник в сфере финансов в Японии. В родной стране его с любовью называют «дзен-миллионером». Кен написал 58 книг (включая «Тайная жизнь денег», бестселлер The New York Times), которые были переведены на 15 языков и проданы тиражом свыше 8 миллионов экземпляров – и с каждым днем это число растет.

Еще в детстве Кен понял, как сильно деньги влияют на нашу жизнь. Это был непростой жизненный урок. Узнав, что друг их семьи лишил жизни себя и свою семью из-за долгов ростовщикам, Кен поставил перед собой цель разобраться, почему такая обыденная вещь, как деньги, в столь значительной мере влияет на наше поведение.

И порой приводит к трагическому исходу.

В итоге Кен запустил множество успешных бизнес-проектов и уже в 29 лет достиг абсолютной финансовой свободы. Однако он все равно продолжает интересоваться природой наших отношений с деньгами. В ходе опроса 12 000 японских миллионеров, которые добились всего сами, Кен, будучи в то время учеником ныне покойного Вахея Такеды («японского Уоррена Баффета»), начал замечать определенные закономерности, характерные для самых богатых, счастливых и довольных жизнью людей.

Как выяснилось, достижение стабильного достатка связано не столько с денежным IQ (стратегиями бизнеса и инвестиций), сколько с денежным EQ (эмоциональным интеллектом в сфере денег).

На этом мастер-классе от Mindvalley Кен поделится с вами своими самыми эффективными идеями и техниками, связанными с искусством управления деньгами, чтобы вы могли исцелиться от финансовых травм и достичь того уровня достатка, которого всегда хотели.

### A 2-Day Deep Dive With the World’s Most In-Demand Master Coaches

If you’re a coach, trainer or consultant in any niche, or you’re in an industry where you’re helping human beings or companies become better…

Then you’re invited to our annual Mindvalley Supercoach Summit 2025 to learn how to **build a 6-figure coaching business… even if you’re starting from zero.**

> Here, you’ll learn from the few elite coaches who’ve built multi-million dollar coaching empires

For two unforgettable days in the iconic city of Amsterdam, join Vishen Lakhiani, Ajit Nawalkha, and your global community of Mindvalley Certified Coaches for a powerful, invite-only Supercoach Summit.

This immersive weekend is your chance to connect in person with the coaches and peers you’ve journeyed with virtually—celebrating breakthroughs, deepening friendships, and learning the success secrets of the world’s top coaches and speakers.

Open exclusively to alumni and current students of Mindvalley’s Certified Coaching programs—including Life Coach, Business Coach, Holobody Coach, 10X Coach, Hypnotherapist, and our newest Money Coach certification—this is your opportunity to level up, celebrate your growth, and experience transformation in one of the world’s most inspiring cities.

He is also the co-founder of Mindvalley’s coaching division, Evercoach, which now serves over 250,000 coaches around the world. Ready to Unleash The Supercoach Within You?
-------------------------------------------

Becoming a world class supercoach calls for more than just adding more coaching techniques into your toolkit. True coaching mastery is about embracing coaching as a way of being. It’s not just about what you do – it’s about who you are.

And at our upcoming Supercoach Summit, you’ll discover how to:

1.  **Identify and attract your ideal clients:** Learn how to craft and refine your brand as a coach so your target audience not only resonates with you, they’re more than willing to pay for your services.
    
2.  **Coach with unshakable confidence:** Show up authentically and effectively for both your current clients and future prospects so you effortlessly nurture deeper connections and trust.
    
3.  **Develop a money mindset and the art of pricing:** Shift your beliefs about money so you can develop compelling packages that not only serve your clients but also rewards you with the abundance you deserve.
    
4.  **Build a well-oiled, efficient coaching practice:** Apply the concept of ‘systems thinking’ to optimize every aspect of your coaching practice, and also gain clarity on your goals and priorities of your business.
    
5.  **Harness the power of artificial intelligence:** Discover cutting-edge AI tools you can apply in your business to rapidly scale more content that captivates your audience and drives engagement.
    
6.  **Master the art of vivid story-telling:** Learn how to deliver powerful messages that stir the soul, and inspire and transform your audience at a deep emotional level.
    
7.  **Craft and sell premium packages at a $100k (or more):** Apply proven, time-tested enrollment principles to attract and convert high-value clients into your coaching programs.
    

The Mindvalley Supercoach Summit 2024 is your solution to learning these strategies (and more) from the master coaches that train coaches, but also how to easily apply them regardless of your experience levels… without struggle or feeling overwhelmed. Join us for free and learn how to kickstart your coaching practice or elevate your existing business – from the inside out – at Mindvalley’s annual Supercoach Summit.

### Explorez les plus hauts niveaux de conscience spirituelle. Et manifestez votre vraie vision de vie.

La Quête _Maîtriser sa Vision de Vie_ par le Dr Michael Beckwith est conçue pour vous aider à gravir les 4 niveaux de conscience spirituelle - chaque étape suscitant de profonds réveils à mesure que vous devenez plus aligné avec votre véritable essence.

Ce processus va bien au-delà des méthodes traditionnelles d'établissement d'objectifs ou de visualisation que vous avez peut-être essayées dans le passé. Au lieu d'intellectualiser votre chemin vers la clarté, vous vous retrouvez à partir d'un lieu de pur instinct et d'inspiration.

C’est ici que vous obtenez une clarté complète de ce que le succès et la réalisation signifient vraiment pour vous - afin que vous puissiez vous épanouir dans l’expression divine de qui vous êtes vraiment.

C'est ainsi que vous vous élèvez au-dessus des objectifs et des activités qui ne vous servent pas. Et libérez le sentiment d'insatisfaction ou de vide qui accompagne une vie spirituellement désalignée.

Au lieu de cela, vous êtes enfin libre de créer une vie qui chante à votre âme.

### Dr Michael Bernard Beckwith sur Maîtriser sa Vision de Vie

**Le Dr Michael Bernard Beckwith** est le fondateur du Centre spirituel international Agape, une communauté spirituelle trans-confessionnelle de plus de 9 000 membres.

Il a été l’invité d’émissions télévisées telles que **Dr. Oz, The Oprah Show, Larry King Live** et a diffusé son message à des millions de personnes via **son programme spécial sur PBS, La Réponse, c’est vous**. Il a également participé, aux côtés du Dalaï Lama et d'autres Ministres de la Nouvelle Pensée, à l’écriture du livre The Synthesis Dialogues.

Le Dr Beckwith est le créateur du Processus de Visionnement, qu'il enseigne dans le monde entier par le biais de ses livres et de ses séminaires. En bref, ce processus est un moyen d'accepter pleinement votre connexion avec le divin et de laisser l'Univers servir le monde à travers vous.

Maîtriser sa Vision de Vie est une Quête merveilleuse, et nous sommes ravis de vous apporter les enseignements de cet homme fantastique.

![Michael Beckwith Author Picture](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/700x760/d0bda3ac7c/lvm_sp_author-m.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

![Michael Beckwith Author Picture](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1200x1300/52e80c9df3/lvm_sp_author-d-min-height.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Références du formateur

*   Présent régulièrement dans des panels de conférences internationaux avec des artisans de paix et des chefs spirituels, y compris le Dalaï Lama.
    
*   Professeur en vedette dans _Le Secret_ : le film de 2006 qui a attiré l'attention du grand public sur la loi de l'attraction.
    
*   S'engage dans une philanthropie mondiale axée sur la préservation de l'environnement et soutient les orphelinats dont les enfants ont survécu à la guerre et au sida.
    
*   Nommé sur la liste _SuperSoul100_ d'Oprah des visionnaires et des leaders influents en 2016.
    

![Michael Beckwith avec Oprah Winfrey](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1000x560/1cc9860804/lvm_sp_reality-infusion-1.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Michael Beckwith est un professeur exceptionnel qui inspire et transforme son public. La photo ci-dessus a été prise lors du A-Fest Portugal 2019.

![Michael Beckwith on stage](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1000x560/3c7d1b72fe/lvm_sp_reality-infusion-2.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Michael Beckwith est un professeur magnifique qui inspire et transforme son public. Photo ci-dessus de A-Fest Portugal 2019.

Le programme (en Français)
--------------------------

### Explorez le Curriculum de Maîtriser sa Vision de Vie

La Quête Maîtriser sa Vision de Vie est un voyage spirituel de 35 jours pour découvrir votre but. Chaque jour, vous rejoindrez le Dr Michael Beckwith et des milliers d’étudiants dans le monde pour vous reconnecter avec qui vous êtes vraiment.

Le Dr Beckwith est l'un des professeurs spirituels les plus éminents de notre temps - et cette Quête est la meilleure chose à faire après une consultation individuelle avec lui. En seulement 15 à 20 minutes par jour, vous monterez à travers les quatre étapes de la conscience spirituelle, acquérant une plus grande clarté sur votre vision et votre but de vie chaque jour qui passe.

À la fin de la Quête, le besoin de lutter et de viser des objectifs devient une chose du passé, et est plutôt remplacé par une vie remplie de synchronicités - alors que vous devenez pleinement aligné avec votre objectif le plus authentique.

![Life Visioning Mastery in various devices](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/2068x1110/4ef677ac8e/lvm_sp_devices_curriculum_fr.png?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Disponible sur votre ordinateur personnel, tablette, smartphone et Apple TV

### Bonus inclus quand vous vous inscrivez aujourd'hui

Bonus #1:

La réponse c'est vous

Dans le programme The Answer Is You, Michael vous aidera à comprendre que tout le pouvoir, la prospérité, la vie, la santé, l'abondance et tout ce que vous méritez sont déjà là. Dans ce programme, des concepts importants sont également exposés, tels que: Vous n'êtes pas le corps, vous avez un corps. Vous n'êtes pas l'esprit, vous avez un esprit. Vous n'êtes pas ici pour l'obtenir, vous êtes ici pour le laisser couler.

![Put some alt text here](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/2048x2048/81899465ad/lvm_sp_bonus_1_fr.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Bonus #2:

Méditation guidée quotidienne

Dans cette méditation guidée de 25 minutes, Michael vous ramène à votre essence, vous laissant dans un état de paix et d'équanimité. Vous pouvez écouter cette méditation guidée à tout moment avant, pendant ou après la quête de maîtrise de la vision de la vie.

![Put some alt text here](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/2048x2048/ae1b06e468/lvm_sp_bonus_2_fr.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Bonus #3:

Méditation de prospérité harmonisante

Dans cette brève méditation, Michael va vous guider pour embrasser l'abondance autour de vous, afin que vous viviez d'un lieu de plénitude et de prospérité continue. Écoutez cette méditation à tout moment avant, pendant ou après la fin de la quête. Il est recommandé d'écouter ce morceau chaque fois que vous remarquez que vous venez d'un lieu de manque et de rareté, et laissez-le vous rappeler la nature de votre abondance.

![Put some alt text here](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/2048x2048/a562fb8aca/lvm_sp_bonus_3_fr.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

For anyone seeking a richer financial future…

Do you find yourself constantly worrying about money?

Does the thought of retirement, investments, or even just monthly budgeting fill you with a sense of dread?

If you ever thought there must be more straightforward ways to manage your finances, ways that the experts and the wealthy seem to know but aren't sharing, you’re not alone…

Unfortunately, the majority of us have been left in the dark when it comes to truly understanding money, leading to a cycle of debt, stress, and financial uncertainty for countless individuals.

But should you really bear the blame for a system that fails to equip you with crucial skills we all deserve?

The truth is, **financial literacy is a right, not a privilege.**

And under the guidance of Jaspreet Singh, the power to change your financial destiny is now firmly in your grasp.

Transform Your Financial Landscape In Just Two Weeks

![Put a good description of the photo here](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1920x1080/e9e4597982/sm-solution.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

‘Smart Money: Your Roadmap to Financial Success’ is a rapid transformational experience that radically redefines how you interact with money.

In just 14 days, dedicating mere minutes each day, you'll dive into a world where managing money, investing wisely, and growing your wealth becomes second nature.

Every strategy, tool, and mindset shift you learn is designed to enhance one of what Jaspreet calls The 3 Keys to Financial Fitness, namely:

1.  **Spend Less**
2.  **Earn More**
3.  **Invest like crazy**

  
Whether you're overwhelmed by debt, confused about investing, or simply seeking a more secure financial future, Jaspreet’s clear, step-by-step approach helps you make intelligent money choices that set you and your family up for life.

Meet your Trainer

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1715070698/mvcom/Author%20Name/type_jaspreet-singh.svg)

The Smart Money

![Vishen](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1600x2400/97ec5a9f05/jaspreet-singh-2_3.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

**Jaspreet Singh** is on a mission to spread financial education.

Jaspreet is the internet sensation behind Minority Mindset, the viral YouTube channel with 2 million subscribers that makes financial education accessible to all.

In a world where the mere mention of money, retirement or investing causes many of us to break out in sweat, Jaspreet cuts through the jargon and makes real and generational wealth an option for anyone who wants to learn.

Jaspreet’s simple no-nonsense advice has already transformed the futures of droves of ever-grateful followers, and now he’s ready to do the same for you.

Trainers Credentials

*   ### Chief Executive Money Nerd at the Minority Mindset Companies and the host of the Minority Mindset YouTube Channel with more than 100M views.
    
*   ### Founder of Buzz Media and the Market Insiders App - providing the financial news you need to be a smarter investor and build more wealth.
    
*   ### Not only is Jaspreet a successful serial entrepreneur and Real Estate Investor, he’s also a Licenced Attorney at Law
    

As seen on

![Forbes logo](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1715679517/logo/logo_gobankingrates.svg)

![Inc](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1715679516/logo/logo_fox4-kdfw.svg)

![CNN](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1715679517/logo/logo_yahoo-finance.svg)

The essential financial education schools forgot to teach:
----------------------------------------------------------

![](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1200x1200/08ce3373ee/sm-stats-image.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

76% millennials

Are not financially literate

72% households

Do not have a financial plan

83% feel better

Within a year of setting financial goals

You’ll grow in these areas:

1.  ### Improving Money Skills
    
2.  ### Getting Out of Debt
    
3.  ### Personal Financial Management
    
4.  ### Investing Skills
    
5.  ### Growing Your Finances
    
6.  ### Earning and Saving Money
    
7.  ### Entrepreneurial Success
    

The curriculum
--------------

Smart Money is your 14-day step-by-step guide with financial expert Jaspreet Singh, designed to empower you with the knowledge and skills for lifelong financial success.

Each day, in just a few minutes, Jaspreet guides you through essential principles of money management, investing, and wealth building.

Designed for immediate application, you’ll start transforming your financial habits and mindset from day one.

By the end of the Quest, you'll not only have a robust understanding of personal finance but also a clear action plan to secure and grow your wealth, regardless of your starting point.

![The Silva Ultramind System on multiple devices](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1920x1080/abc35d14c1/sm-curriculum.png?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Highlights

Day by day

Part 1

#### Money 101

Show breakdown

Begin your journey to financial empowerment, where we redefine your relationship with money through the Quadrafit theory and the 3 Keys to Financial Fitness. This segment is tailored to shift your mindset and nail the core competencies of money management.

*   **Embrace the Quadrafit Theory:** Dive into the interconnectedness of physical, mental, spiritual, and financial health. Discover how balancing these elements is crucial for true wealth and well-being, setting the stage for a comprehensive approach to financial success.
*   **Good Debt vs. Bad Debt:** Unravel the nuances of 'Good Debt' and its impact on your assets. Learn from Jaspreet when incurring debt makes sense and how to choose between The Debt Avalanche and The Debt Snowball methods for rapid debt elimination. The Truth About Credit Cards: Transform credit cards from debt traps into powerful financial tools with Jaspreet's simple rules, ensuring you benefit without paying interest.
*   **Why Saving Might Not Be That Smart:** Explore the three essential reasons to save money and how the 75/15/10 rule can be a game-changer in your wealth growth journey.
*   **How to Escape The Net Zero Mindset:** Understand the key differences between assets and liabilities with The Simple Rule of 5, empowering you to make financially sound decisions.
*   **And much, much more…**

Part 2

#### Making your money work for you

Show breakdown

Part 2 of the Quest is where your financial empowerment truly takes flight. Here, we dive deep into savvy investment strategies and wealth-building techniques, turning theory into real-world financial success.

*   **Unlock the Power of Investment Strategies:** Discover how to unlock financial freedom through passive and active investing. Learn to think like the wealthy, transforming "I can't afford this" into "How can I afford this?" and open doors to new income streams.
*   **Demystify the Stock Market:** Delve into the exciting world of stocks and bonds. Become savvy in stock market navigation, from understanding dividends to mastering old-school valuation techniques, making you a smart player in the investment game.
*   **Real Estate Mastery Unleashed:** Step into the lucrative realm of real estate investing. Learn to pick winning properties, crunch numbers like a pro, and turn real estate into a cornerstone of your wealth-building strategy.
*   **Crafting Streams of Passive Income:** Venture beyond traditional income sources. Unearth the secrets of creating diverse passive income channels that work for you, ensuring a steady flow of wealth even as you sleep.
*   **Design Your Path to Financial Liberation:** The final leap towards true financial independence. Master the art of wealth protection and growth through sophisticated planning – from estate strategies to tax optimization, paving your way to a future where financial freedom is your reality.

This part of the Quest not only educates you on different investment avenues but also equips you with the tools and confidence to make your money work for you, setting a clear path to financial freedom.

What You’ll Learn

1.  ### Master the Money Mindset
    
    Unlock the same money mindset that has long been the secret of the wealthy: a mindset of abundance that effortlessly attracts and builds wealth, rather than perpetuating scarcity.
    
2.  ### Step Beyond Financial Fear
    
    Confidently step into new opportunities, applying strategies once thought beyond reach to achieve groundbreaking financial success.
    
3.  ### Income Optimization
    
    Turn every paycheck into a growth opportunity. You've unlocked the secrets of income maximization, stretching your earnings to their fullest potential for a richer life.
    
4.  ### Strategic Budgeting
    
    Master the art of budgeting where every dollar is strategically allocated. Handle unexpected expenses with ease, and watch your wealth grow as you follow a budget that aligns with your financial goals.
    
5.  ### Investing Made Simple
    
    Become a confident investor, turning market fluctuations into opportunities for predictable gains. You're now making smart, informed decisions that steadily build your financial portfolio.
    
6.  ### Amplify Your Finances
    
    Witness the transformation of your financial landscape as you apply ingenious strategies and tap into new streams of passive income, turning modest savings into a significant nest egg.
    
7.  ### From Debt Management to Debt Freedom
    
    Understand the difference between ‘good debt’ and ‘bad debt’ for deep peace of mind and how to never pay a penny of interest on your credit cards.

Êtes-vous d'accord que le stress et les épreuves font inévitablement partie de la vie ?

Si c'est le cas, imaginez être si calme et résilient(e) face à votre prochaine vague d'agitation et de difficulté... que vous vous surprenez à la naviguer avec facilité, paix et assurance, là où d'autres couleraient désespérément.

Et, alors que les cieux s'éclaircissent, imaginez à quel point le reste du voyage serait gratifiant...

Si vous pouviez alors faire appel à l'expression la plus complète de votre intelligence intérieure, à la sagesse intemporelle des anciens maîtres et même à la volonté de l'Univers lui-même, pour atteindre la terre promise :

Un lieu où vos rêves les plus fous sont désormais votre réalité au quotidien.

Selon le Professeur Srikumar Rao, l'un des conférenciers en MBA les plus demandés au monde, le scénario ci-dessus est possible pour tous, peu importe vos défis personnels, vos déclencheurs de stress ou vos aspirations.

Et tout commence en adoptant une philosophie remarquable qui vous pousse à suivre le cours de la vie, alors que vous puisez dans des pouvoirs à couper le souffle se trouvant en vous et autour de vous, pour atteindre une maîtrise de vous-même et de votre potentiel ultimes.

Bienvenue à La Quête pour la maîtrise de soi.

Obtenez la liberté d’être connecté(e) à la vie, et atteignez une résilience extraordinaire, l’abondance et la maîtrise de soi

Le programme de _La Quête pour la maîtrise de soi_ offre une rare opportunité de faire l’expérience de l’unique approche de la croissance personnelle et de la résilience de Srikumar Rao, qui combine la sagesse des anciens poètes et philosophes, des vérités universelles intemporelles et votre propre intelligence inhérente et infinie.

Par le biais d’un cadre spirituel magnifiquement optimisé, votre esprit et votre âme sont reconditionnés avec les mêmes révélations éprouvées par le temps et la sagesse bouleversante que Srikumar Rao partage avec les meilleurs PDGs du monde, les cadres et dirigeants intellectuels lors de TED Talks et de conférences autour du monde.

Que vous soyez un(e) professionnel(-le) ou un(e) entrepreneur(-euse) en quête d’un plus grand accomplissement, ou encore juste une personne à la recherche d’une avancée ou d’une solution face à l’adversité ou de la force nécessaire à affronter une transition de vie importante ou stressante, toute votre approche de la vie évoluera à mesure que vous découvrirez comment :

*   **Faire face à des situations stressantes,** - non pas avec de la peur ou de l’anxiété, mais l’assurance que ce que vous rencontrez est une opportunité de croissance et d’apprentissage...
    
*   Accéder **à une voix intérieure forte** qui vous guide, vous empêche d’être la « victime » de forces au-delà de votre contrôle et vous dirige sur la bonne voie...
    
*   Vous nouer rapidement d’amitié et **faire équipe avec l’Univers** pour co-créer une « réalité » nouvelle et excitante enracinée dans une approche de la vie « centrée sur le nous »...
    
*   Et cultiver la détermination inébranlable de **surmonter les obstacles** grâce à des **techniques de recadrage puissantes** pour que vous puissiez transformer la « tragédie », peu importe ce qui se passe autour de vous.
    

En bref, tous les modèles passés de lutte, d’incertitude, de tension émotionnelle, de doute de soi et de faiblesse deviendront des souvenirs distants pour vous, puisqu’avec les conseils de Srikumar Rao, vous vous élevez aux plus hauts niveaux possibles de maîtrise et de conscience de soi.

Le programme

Explorer le programme de La Quête pour la maîtrise de soi

La Quête pour la maîtrise de soi est un programme en ligne de 45 jours qui réveille votre capacité optimale à la paix intérieure, la résilience et la maîtrise de soi tout en vous ouvrant au soutien et à la direction de l’Univers lui-même.

Avec Srikumar Rao lui-même en tant que guide, vous serez guidé(e) à travers un programme magnifiquement optimisé qui ne prend que 10 à 15 minutes par jour.

Chaque outil, cadre mental et technique dont vous avez besoin pour atteindre cet état élusif de maîtrise de soi est inclus pour vous dans ce programme. Vous n’avez qu’à suivre les conseils de Srikumar Rao, à mesure qu’il vous présente des vérités et des idées qui enflammeront votre potentiel humain optimal.

Professeur Srikumar Rao, créateur de La Quête pour la maîtrise de soi

Professeur Srikumar Rao est un orateur international, auteur de best-sellers et l’un des conférenciers de MBA les plus populaires des États-Unis. Ses cours figurent parmi les mieux notés dans beaucoup des meilleures écoles de commerce, dont l’Université Columbia et la London Business School.

Srikumar Rao consulte régulièrement pour les cadres dirigeants et les entrepreneurs d’entreprises comme Google, Microsoft, IBM, United Airlines, John & Johnson et beaucoup d’autres, dans des domaines comme le sens, l’objectif, la performance et le leadership.

Intervenant régulier de Forbes, Inc.com et CEO.com, ses perspectives sur les stratégies d’affaires et les dimensions spirituelles de la réussite sont très recherchées par diverses chaînes médiatiques.

La formation de Srikumar Rao est si populaire que les participants doivent joindre une liste d’attente d’un an avant d’y accéder. Le programme de La Quête pour la maîtrise de soi fait partie intégrante de son objectif d’étendre ses enseignements à un public plus large, pour qu’une plus grande partie de l’humanité puisse bénéficier de ses idées transformatives et de ses cadres de travail.

Des événements extraordinaires se produisent quand vous commencez à évoluer dans tous les domaines de votre vie avec l'Abonnement Mindvalley :

![Puzzle icon](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1653546558/Icons/Hexagon%20Icons/Coloured%20Icons%20%28opacity%29/hex-target-teal.svg)

### Vous développez instantanément des habitudes vous rendant très performant(e)

Quand vous lisez un livre ou suivez un cours, vous vous retrouvez souvent dans un « état d'euphorie temporaire » qui s'évapore avec le temps. Mindvalley vous transforme de façon permanente grâce à des outils de pointe pour le changement de comportement qui installent en vous des habitudes, croyances et schémas émotionnels stimulants. Ainsi, les performances de pointe, la santé éclatante, la paix inébranlable et la joie sans limites deviennent vos réglages par défaut.

![Rocket icon](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1653546556/Icons/Hexagon%20Icons/Coloured%20Icons%20%28opacity%29/hex-lightbulb-yellow.svg)

### Votre esprit, votre corps et votre âme atteignent une productivité surhumaine

Peu importe ce que vous souhaitez atteindre ou devenir, Mindvalley vous soutient sous tous les angles. Allez bien au-delà des astuces basiques relatives à la productivité et maîtrisez les états de Flow, des niveaux profonds de conscience, des outils de pointe en matière d'état d'esprit et même des outils spirituels révolutionnant vos ressentis ainsi que votre façon de penser, d'affirmer votre présence, de relever des défis et d'accomplir des tâches.

![Leaf icon](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1653546558/Icons/Hexagon%20Icons/Coloured%20Icons%20%28opacity%29/hex-trending-up-green.svg)

### Vous évoluez et vous épanouissez dans chaque dimension importante de votre vie

Combien de personnes sont riches et prospères, mais en mauvaise santé ? Ou en forme et débordantes de vie, mais fauchées ? Avec Mindvalley, vous n'avez pas besoin de sacrifier un domaine de votre vie pour un autre, car vous obtenez les meilleurs outils et conseils pour activer votre génie dans tous les domaines. Ainsi, vous pouvez avoir l'apparence d'un super-héros, en être un au travail, pour vos enfants, votre famille et même le monde, et vraiment tout avoir.

![Hand holding a heart icon](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1653546554/Icons/Hexagon%20Icons/Coloured%20Icons%20%28opacity%29/hex-heart-pink.svg)

### Vous créez des connexions ayant un impact et élevant votre vie

Vous rejoindrez notre communauté globale rassemblant plus de 70 000 acteurs de changement puissants et évoluant chaque jour. Mais ces personnes sortent de l'ordinaire : il s'agit d'entrepreneurs hautement influents, d'artistes brillants, de penseurs visionnaires et d'individus profondément inspirants engagés dans l'élévation de leur être et de la planète. Vous vous connecterez et évoluerez avec eux chaque jour grâce à des événements réservés aux membres de Mindvalley, des rassemblements, des ateliers en direct et bien d'autres événements ayant lieu dans votre ville et aux quatre coins du monde.

Frequently asked questions
--------------------------

Browse answers to your questions about program access, billing, and Mindvalley Membership. Need more help? Visit [https://support.mindvalley.com](https://support.mindvalley.com/)
 and we'll get back to you ASAP.

### How much does Mindvalley coach certification cost?

The cost of a Mindvalley Coach Certification depends on the specific path you choose (whether as a life coach, business coach, or hypnotherapist) and the availability of active promotions from Mindvalley. Each certification track has its own structure and payment plan. For the latest pricing and enrollment options, visit the Mindvalley official certifications page, where you’ll find detailed breakdowns and financing options for each program.

### Is it worth getting life coach certification?

Yes, earning a life coach certification is often worth it, especially if you want to coach professionally or deepen your personal growth journey. Programs like Mindvalley’s Life Coach Certification provide structured, hands-on training in coaching frameworks, communication, and business building. You’ll graduate with the skills and confidence to help your clients transform their lives, and a credential that signals real credibility in a growing global industry.

### How much does it cost to get ICF certified?

The cost of obtaining recognition from the International Certification Federation (ICF) varies depending on the provider and level, whether you’re aiming to be an associate certified coach (ACC), a professional certified coach (PCC), or a master certified coach (MCC). Prices typically range from $3,000 to over $15,000, depending on the number of training hours, mentor coaching, and evaluation fees. Many choose Mindvalley’s ICF-accredited certifications because they bundle high-level coaching training, business strategy, and mentorship in one cohesive system. In this way, they offer exceptional value compared to assembling separate components.

### Is Mindvalley coaching worth it?

In short? Yes. Mindvalley’s coach certification programs are a strong investment for anyone serious about personal growth and professional impact. Each program combines expert-led training with proven coaching models and business tools to help you build a thriving practice. Beyond the certification itself, you’ll join a global network of coaches and mentors who share your mission of elevating human potential.

### What type of coaching is most in demand?

Life coaching, business coaching, and hypnotherapy remain among the most in-demand areas in the coaching and wellness industries. Global studies by the International Coaching Federation (ICF) and LinkedIn highlight rising demand for guidance in personal growth, leadership, and mental well-being—all key focuses of Mindvalley coach certification programs.

### Can you make 6 figures as a life coach?

Yes, it’s absolutely possible to earn a six-figure income as a life coach with the proper training, strategy, and consistency. Many certified coaches reach that level by combining strong coaching skills with innovative business systems and niche positioning. Mindvalley’s certifications, for one, enable you to do precisely that: blend transformation tools with marketing and business growth strategies that turn passion into a sustainable, high-income career.

### Can I be a coach without certification?

Well, you can technically coach without a certification, as there are no universal legal requirements that mandate it. However, earning one, through accredited programs like the Mindvalley Coach Certification courses, provides you with the structure, credibility, and confidence to truly succeed and stand out. Plus, being certified demonstrates to clients that you’ve been trained in ethical standards and effective methods, which helps build trust and accelerates your success as a professional coach.

The Mindvalley Coach Certification equips coaches with cutting-edge tools and methodologies to guide individuals in various aspects of personal growth, from mindset and well-being to career and relationships. With [Ajit](https://www.mindvalley.com/trainers/ajit)
 and other industry experts as your guides, the programs help you unlock your full potential and achieve transformative results by applying Mindvalley’s renowned teachings and frameworks in a personalized coaching setting. ### What is a life coach not allowed to do?

A life coach is not allowed to diagnose or treat mental health conditions, prescribe medication, or offer legal or financial advice. Their role is to help clients identify goals, overcome obstacles, and develop strategies for personal and professional growth, leveraging skills often learned through comprehensive life coach training. A coach provides support and guidance and must operate within their scope of practice, focusing on client empowerment and actionable steps.

### How long does it take to become a certified life coach?

The time it takes to become a certified life coach can vary significantly, depending on the program and your personal pace. Some intensive life coach certification programs can be completed in as little as 3–6 months. Others might take 12–24 months. Factors like program structure (self-paced vs. cohort-based) and the number of required practice hours also influence the duration.

Mindvalley’s Certified Life Coach program takes about four months (16 weeks) to complete. It’s an online certification that blends pre-recorded lessons with live cohort experiences, covering core coaching skills, a 4-Part Coaching Process, and meditation techniques. The curriculum is aligned with International Coaching Federation (ICF) standards, offering both structure and flexibility for different learning paces.

### How much does Mindvalley certification cost?

Mindvalley’s certification costs vary depending on the track (life coaching, business coaching, hypnotherapy, etc.). Many of the coaching-certification programs at Mindvalley are not included in the standard membership and instead carry a separate one-time tuition payment. For the most accurate current pricing, payment plan options, and intake dates, you should [check the individual program page on Mindvalley’s website](https://www.mindvalley.com/certs)
.

### Does Mindvalley offer certifications?

Yes, Mindvalley offers a variety of certifications, including the Mindvalley Certified Life Coach program. These certifications are designed to provide in-depth training and official recognition for your expertise in various fields. They also equip you with the tools and knowledge to guide others effectively, blending advanced personal growth principles with practical coaching methodologies. You can explore all available certification programs, like becoming a [Mindvalley Certified Life Coach](https://www.mindvalley.com/certs/life)
, directly on our website.

### How much does a life coach typically charge?

The cost of a life coach can vary significantly based on their experience, specialization, location, and the coaching package offered. Generally, you can expect to pay anywhere from $75 to $500 per session, with some highly sought-after coaches charging even more. Many coaches offer packages for multiple sessions, which can sometimes reduce the per-session cost. When considering life coach training, it's important to understand the value and potential return on investment.

### How do I get certified as a life coach?

To [become a certified life coach](https://blog.mindvalley.com/how-to-become-a-life-coach/)
, you typically need to complete an accredited life coaching program, like the Mindvalley Certified Life Coach. These programs cover essential coaching methodologies, ethics, and practical skills. Look for programs that offer comprehensive life coaching courses and are recognized by reputable industry bodies. Upon successful completion of the coursework, practical training, and often an examination, you'll receive your certification. This credential demonstrates your expertise and commitment to professional coaching standards, helping you establish credibility with clients.
