Der Body & Health Summit startet in:

[kostenlos registrieren](https://www.mindvalley.com/de/summit/health#join-the-program)

Ein kostenloses 3-tägiges LIVE-Event (auf Englisch) mit führenden Gesundheitsexperten, die erklären, was es wirklich bedeutet, gesund zu sein.

Mindvalley Health & Body Summit 2024

Entdecke die einfachsten Wege, um Krankheiten vorzubeugen, in deine Ideal-Figur zu kommen und ganzheitliches Wohlbefinden zu verbessern - auch wenn du bei Null anfängst.

![Put a good description of the photo here](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1920x1080/0c382f7719/body_maincover.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Erhalte topaktuelles Wissen und nachhaltige Strategien, um deine Gesundheit langfristig zu verbessern.

![Students icon](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1687751400/Icons/UI%20Icons/ico_solid_users.svg)

15,000+

Teilnehmende

* * *

![Mic icon](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1687751400/Icons/UI%20Icons/ico_solid_speaker.svg)

5

Sprecher\*innen

* * *

![Calendar icon](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1687751400/Icons/UI%20Icons/ico_solid_calendar.svg)

17.-19. Mai

Datum

![Mindvalley Summit Speakers](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1920x1080/e50ed89bda/updated_bhs_speakers-lineup.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

![Mindvalley Social Media Summit 2023 Speakers](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/1029x1179/8435cab305/updated_bhs_speakers-lineup_1029x1179-p_s_.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

Wenn es dir gelingt, deine Gesundheit zu verbessern, wird sich auch alles andere im Leben verbessern.

Die Welt ist nicht darauf ausgelegt, uns gesund zu halten.

Wir sind Teil einer kranken Gesellschaft.

> In einer Welt, in der Billionen-Dollar-Industrien von einer kranken Gesellschaft profitieren - sind Stress, Autoimmunerkrankungen und Fettleibigkeit die neue Normalität.

Aber die Wahrheit ist, du musst kein Fitnessfanatiker, Biochemiker oder Ernährungsexperte sein, um schnell und einfach drastische Verbesserungen deiner Gesundheit vorzunehmen.

**Dieser Summit ist für dich oder jemanden in deiner Nähe:**

*   Leidet unter anhaltenden gesundheitlichen Problemen, die durch Stress und chronische Entzündungen verursacht werden.
    
*   Hat Schwierigkeiten mit widersprüchlichen Ernährungsinformationen und nicht nachhaltigen Trainingsregimen.
    
*   Hat versucht, gesunde Gewohnheiten zu etablieren, ist jedoch gescheitert oder wiederholt vom Fitnesspfad abgekommen.
    
*   Sind es leid, sich mit lästigen Rücken-, Nacken-, Knie- oder anderen muskuloskelettalen Schmerzen herumzuschlagen.
    
*   Fühlt sich resigniert gegenüber dem zunehmenden Gesundheitszustand und betrachtet es als "einen Teil des Älterwerdens".
    
*   Möchtest bis ins hohe Alter mobil bleiben und einen starken, gesunden Körper behalten.
    
*   Sucht nach den schnellsten und einfachsten Möglichkeiten, die Gesundheit und die Körperform schnell zu verbessern.
    

Auf dem Mindvalley Health and Body Summit werden wir dir die Prinzipien vermitteln, die du sofort anwenden kannst, um jeden Aspekt deiner Gesundheit zu transformieren, egal wo du im Leben stehst.

Egal, ob du schwer krank bist oder gesund und einfach nur superfit werden möchtest, dieser Summit bringt einige der unglaublichen Köpfe zusammen und ist komplett KOSTENLOS, und du wirst viele unkonventionelle Wahrheiten und hochmoderne neue Protokolle lernen, die dir helfen, schnell gesund zu werden.

Triff deine Health & Body Summit Sprecher:innen

![author name](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1676366625/mvcom/Author%20Name/type_ronan-diego.svg)

Health and Fitness Expert

![author name](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/360x540/8d08afdf16/hb_speaker_ronan-d.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=2&width=auto)

**Ronan Diego**, Mindvalleys Leiter für Gesundheit und Fitness, entwickelt ganzheitliche Wellnessprogramme, die Mind-Body-Praktiken, intermittierendes Fasten und Körperpositivität mit hyperoptimiertem Fitnesstraining integrieren. Sein umfassender Ansatz ermöglicht es Einzelpersonen, optimale Gesundheit durch wissenschaftlich fundierte Methoden und zugängliche Fitnessstrategien zu erreichen. Schließe dich Ronan auf dem Summit an, um transformative Gesundheitstechniken zu erkunden, die physisches, mentales und emotionales Wohlbefinden umfassen.

Gaining followers

7-figure social media business

Entrepreneurship

Brand Monetization

![Vishen](https://res.cloudinary.com/mindvalley/image/upload/v1639386266/mvcom/Author%20Name/type_vishen.svg)

Bist du bereit, die Kontrolle über deine Gesundheit und dein Wohlbefinden zurückzugewinnen?

In 3 Tagen, die randvoll mit Informationen sind, erhältst du Zugang zu unschätzbaren Strategien von den weltbesten Expertinnen und Experten für Gesundheit, Ernährung, Fitness und Geist-Körper-Verbindung, die dir tausende Euro für wirkungslose Behandlungen ersparen könnten.

Diese sind einfache, aber spielverändernde Prinzipien, die vollständig unter deiner eigenen Kontrolle liegen und die du heute beginnen kannst anzuwenden, um sofort besser auszusehen und dich besser zu fühlen.

Anhaltende Beschwerden, lästige Ängste, sogar langfristige Gewichtsprobleme und hartnäckige schlechte Gewohnheiten können überraschend schnell verschwinden, wenn du systematisch die Kernprobleme angehst: Jede Veranstaltung ist Teil eines von vier unterschiedlichen und einzigartigen persönlichen Entwicklungsbereichen deines Lebens.

Wenn du dir deinen kostenlosen Platz sicherst, erhältst du Zugang zu einem vollen 3-tägigen Programm.

1.  **Nachhaltiges Gewichtsmanagement**: Verstehe, was für deinen Körper funktioniert, selbst wenn du bereits mehrere Diäten ausprobiert hast und nichts zu klappen scheint.
    
2.  **Stressabbau und körperliche Entspannung**: 80% der Arztbesuche stehen mit Stress in Verbindung. Du wirst eine einfache Entspannungstechnik erlernen, um ihn auf Knopfdruck zu reduzieren.
    
3.  **Stoffwechselneustart**: Entdecke die Geheimnisse zum Neustart deines Stoffwechsels mit diätetischen Veränderungen, die deine Energie und Gehirnfunktion steigern - erhalte klare, umsetzbare Schritte.
    
4.  **Bekämpfung chronischer Entzündungen**: Entdecke ernährungs- und bewegungsbezogene Lösungen, um diese zugrunde liegende Ursache vieler chronischer Erkrankungen zu bekämpfen.
    
5.  **Darmgesundheit für geistiges und körperliches Wohlbefinden**: Dein Darmmikrobiom ist mit fast jeder großen Erkrankung verbunden - Autoimmun-, Verdauungsstörungen, Reizdarmsyndrom, Diabetes, Fettleibigkeit, sogar Depressionen und Angstzustände - hier lernst du effektive Möglichkeiten, dein Mikrobiom wiederherzustellen.
    
6.  **Muskel- und Krafttraining:** Wehre Sarkopenie und Muskelabbau mit einfachem, angenehmem Widerstandstraining ab, das dich stark hält, während du älter wirst.
    
7.  **Erholung und Biohacking:** Nutze die neuesten Biohacking-Tools, um die Erholung zu beschleunigen und deine Energielevel zu verstärken - werde schneller als je zuvor wieder zu 100% fit.
    
8.  **Befreiung von ungesunden Gewohnheiten:** Überwinde Verhaltens- und psychologische Barrieren und bringe Selbstdisziplin auf Autopilot, um dich natürlich auf deine Gesundheitsziele zuzubewegen.
    

Der Mindvalley Health & Body Summit im Mai 2024 ist deine Eintrittskarte, um diese Strategien von Top-Experten auf eine transformative Weise zu meistern, die die wichtigsten Gesundheitsindikatoren verändert, aber es automatisch, mühelos und angenehm macht - unabhängig von deinem Alter oder wo du gerade stehst.

To the present or aspiring leader ready to rise up to the challenges of a new world:

The idea of leadership as you may know it is dead.

In fact the kind of person who was once considered a great leader years ago (or even months ago) - could now be seen as inadequate.

And so it’s no surprise that today’s top performing and most resilient entrepreneurs, human resource officers, and C-suite executives are waking up to the same truth:

There is no going back to ‘normal’. There will be no more ‘business as usual’. The world is now a permanently different place, and it’s demanding a different kind of leader.

In this world, those who stick to the old rules will sink. While those who evolve will reap extraordinary rewards, while rapidly expanding their influence and impact.

Few know this more profoundly than Keith Ferrazzi.

Keith is one of the world’s leading business consultants, whose guidance and insights are coveted by many of today’s most influential companies and professionals.

And by observing and collaborating with the top performers in these organizations - those creating consistent, extraordinary success even in times of disruption - he has mapped out a bulletproof blueprint that answers the crucial question:

“What does it really take to effectively lead - and thrive - in this unfamiliar new reality?”

Welcome to the Ultimate Leadership program.

### The Ultimate Blueprint For Leadership In The New Era Of Business

The Ultimate Leadership program is a series of paradigm shifts, strategic frameworks, and transformational tools that profoundly evolve your understanding of and approach to leadership - in line with a rapidly changing world.

It is the culmination of Keith Ferrazzi’s decades of work with leading companies, C-suite executives, and leaders driving innovative and high-performing teams - along with the critical shifts these top performers are making to survive and thrive in the new landscape.

No matter where you’re at in your leadership journey (or even if you’re still aspiring to be one) - the clarity and momentum you gain through this program will dramatically enhance your performance in every key marker of effective leadership.

**Revolutionize Your Relationship With Your Team & Co-Workers**

Ultimate Leadership is more than just a passive program - it’s a step-by-step process for envisioning and nurturing a new relationship between you and your team.

You’ll assess old shared behaviors, habits, and rituals. Discard what doesn’t serve you. Strengthen what does. And set and achieve ‘moonshot’ visions that rocket yourself and every team member towards your fullest potential.

Keith calls this process Recontracting: because it’s about creating a new contract that guides you and your team towards peak performance in eight key dimensions:

**The 8 Dimensions Of Ultimate Leadership**

*   **Candor:** speaking with courage, openness, and sincerity
    
*   **Collaboration:** co-creating for peak performance and innovation
    
*   **Teaming Out:** breaking down silos and merging each team member’s strengths
    
*   **Accountability:** leaving nobody behind and crossing the finish line together
    
*   **Development:** proactively coaching, guiding, and empowering each other
    
*   **Energy:** drawing on each other’s individual’s energy to uplift the team
    
*   **Relationships:** committing to each other’s success and fulfillment
    
*   **Outcomes:** creating exponential and extraordinary transformation
    
*   **No Status Quo:** releasing old disempowering patterns in favor of optimized new ones

Ultimate Leadership is a 21-day online program designed to elevate you into an effective leader for today’s authenticity and collaboration-focused business landscape.

Through a series of easy-to-follow daily video lessons, you’ll join Keith Ferrazzi himself as he meets you where you’re at - and builds you into an extraordinary leader capable of strategizing, motivating, and navigating your team to victory.

In just 20 minutes a day, you’ll rapidly level up your leadership skills through strategies and frameworks Keith has drawn from years of collaboration with the world’s top CEOs and professionals - including the breakthrough epiphanies they’re using at this very moment to assure sustained success in times of uncertainty.

Frequently asked questions

Browse answers to the most popular questions around the main topic. Get bite-size pieces of information and actionable tips you can put into practice right away.

### Why do I struggle with manifesting?

The process of manifestation involves aligning your thoughts, emotions, beliefs, and actions with your desires. And this can be a struggle for many.

_“Too many people never get what they desire in their lives because they never actually claim what they want,”_ explains Regan Hillyer, an energetic coach and the trainer of Mindvalley’s **The Art of Manifesting** Quest. _“They never actually get clear on what they’re asking for, so in some ways we have to teach ourselves to dream again.”_

There are several hurdles that can pop up during this manifestation journey. These include:

1.  Lack of clarity regarding your desires,
2.  Limiting beliefs,
3.  Doubts,
4.  Negative self-talk, and
5.  Negative thought patterns.

To overcome these struggles, manifestation courses can be immensely helpful, like the ones you can take at Mindvalley.

These programs explore the principles of manifestation, including the law of attraction, and teach practical methods for removing limiting beliefs, shifting mindsets, and visualizing goals. Moreover, they provide valuable guidance and techniques to align your thoughts, emotions, and actions with your desires.

By participating in these online courses in manifestation, you gain valuable insights from experienced instructors like Regan Hillyer, Michael Beckwith, and Christie Marie Sheldon, to name a few. What’s more, you become part of a supportive community that helps you overcome obstacles and manifest with greater clarity, confidence, and effectiveness.

### What is the most powerful manifestation method?

This depends on personal preferences and resonance. However, one of the most powerful manifestation methods that’s widely recognized and effective is visualization.

It involves creating vivid mental imagery of your desired outcomes and experiences. So let’s say you have a deep desire to start your own coaching business. To activate the creative power of your mind and align your subconscious with your conscious intentions, you can imagine yourself already living and experiencing the reality of running a successful coaching practice.

Mindvalley’s manifestation courses delve into various techniques, including visualization, to help you harness the power of your imagination. **The Art of Manifesting** Quest with Regan Hillyer, **Life Visioning Mastery** Quest with Michael Beckwith, and **Sixth Sense Superpower** Quest with Sonia Choquette are some of the best manifestation courses out there. They provide step-by-step guidance on refining your visualization practice and enhancing your ability to manifest your desires.

It’s important to note that while visualization is a powerful manifestation method, it works best when combined with aligned thoughts, emotions, and actions. By integrating visualization into a holistic manifestation approach, you can amplify your manifestation potential and manifest your dreams more effectively.

### How do you manifest for beginners?

Manifestation is accessible to everyone, including beginners. However, there are some key steps to get started on nurturing the connection with your soul:

1.  **Clarify your desires**. Clearly identify and articulate what you want to manifest. Be specific and detailed about your intentions.
2.  **Align your thoughts and emotions**. Practice gratitude, affirmations, and positive self-talk to shift your mindset.
3.  **Take inspired action**. Manifestation is not solely about wishful thinking; it requires taking actionable steps toward your goals. Act in alignment with your intentions and seize opportunities that arise.
4.  **Visualize your desires**. Engage in visualization exercises, mentally picturing yourself already experiencing your desired outcomes. Make it as vivid and real as possible, feeling the emotions associated with your manifestation.
5.  **Release resistance**. Let go of any doubts, fears, or limiting beliefs that may hinder your manifestation. Trust in the process and have faith that your desires are on their way to you.

To support your journey, consider learning more about this practice with visualization or the law of attraction courses, like those at Mindvalley. Designed for beginners and advanced alike, they provide practical tools, techniques, and guidance from prominent experts to help you manifest your dreams.

Вы получаете гарантию возврата денег в течение 15 дней с момента покупки Подписки — как годовой, так и месячной. Если за этот период вы решите, что Подписка вам не подходит, вы можете без труда вернуть деньги на странице mindvalley.com/ru/refund.

**Для отказа от Подписки:**

Если вы решите не продлевать Подписку на следующий месяц/год, ее можно отменить в [разделе оплаты](https://beta.mindvalley.com/billing)

**При покупке через приложение:**

Покупки, сделанные в нашем приложении, регулируются правилами отмены и возврата, действующими в соответствующих магазинах приложений (Apple Store и Google Play Store), и на них не распространяются вышеуказанные условия.

### Могу ли я оплатить в рассрочку?

К сожалению, это предложение не предусматривает оплату в рассрочку. Однако вы можете выбрать ежемесячный формат Подписки, чтобы более гибко управлять своими финансами.

### Stories from Mindvalley members

Frequently asked questions
--------------------------

Browse answers to your questions on program access, billing, and Mindvalley Membership. Need more help? Reach out to us at [https://support.mindvalley.com](https://support.mindvalley.com/)
 and we’ll get back to you ASAP.

### Can I enroll in a particular Quest without becoming a Mindvalley Member?

A Mindvalley Membership is required to access any Mindvalley Quest. As a Mindvalley Member, you enjoy unlimited access to all Quests anytime, anywhere, for as long as your subscription is active.

Additionally, you'll join an exclusive community, fostering connections, and engaging with new and upcoming quests, accredited authors, exclusive events, and more.

_Note: Premium programs like the Mindvalley Mastery and Certification series, as well as partner programs like WildFit and Lifebook, are not included._

### How do I choose the Quests I want to take?

Upon successful payment and order confirmation, you will immediately gain access to our entire library of Quests, you will be able to personalize your curriculum through our AI-based assessment and much more in your Mindvalley account.

### How do I cancel or get a refund if I’m not satisfied?

**For refund:**

You have a 15-day money-back guarantee when you make a purchase directly through our website. This applies to your initial subscription fee, whether it's annual or monthly. If you find that our service isn’t quite what you were looking for, simply visit [mindvalley.com/refund](https://mindvalley.com/refund)
 for a hassle-free refund process.

Please note, that obtaining a refund will immediately revoke access to your membership subscription benefits, including all Quests.

**For cancellation:**

Should you choose not to renew your subscription, cancellation is straightforward. Just go to the [Billing Section](https://beta.mindvalley.com/billing)
 of your account to cancel. This ensures you won’t incur future charges, but you’ll retain access to your subscription content until the end of your current billing cycle.

**For In-App Purchases:**

Purchases made within our app are bound by the cancellation and refund policies of the respective app stores (Apple Store and Google Play Store) and are not eligible for the benefits outlined above.

### Can I pay in instalments?

Unfortunately, this offer doesn’t include installment options. However, you can select a monthly subscription to manage your payments with greater flexibility.

### How much is a subscription to Mindvalley?

For the most updated pricing details and to explore all the benefits of Mindvalley’s rich library of products, please visit the official Mindvalley website at [mindvalley.com/membership](https://www.mindvalley.com/mindvalley.com/membership)
. This single subscription unlocks all content, including an AI-powered coach, over 110 programs and meditations, as well as community events, making it a great value for personal growth and learning.

### Is Mindvalley credible?

Yes, Mindvalley is widely considered a credible platform for personal growth and education. Founded by [Vishen Lakhiani](https://www.mindvalley.com/trainers/vishen)
, it offers a diverse range of programs taught by renowned experts in various fields like mindfulness, health, and entrepreneurship. Mindvalley's credibility is supported by its large global community, positive user testimonials, and partnerships with leading educators. While individual results may vary, the platform consistently delivers high-quality content designed to help users unlock their full potential.

### What does Mindvalley Membership get you?

A Mindvalley Membership unlocks unlimited access to over 110+ Quests (courses) from world-class teachers. This includes popular programs on [personal growth](https://blog.mindvalley.com/personal-growth/)
, health, entrepreneurship, and relationships, such as "The 6-Phase Meditation" by Vishen Lakhiani and "Superbrain" by Jim Kwik. You also gain entry to the Mindvalley community, live classes, workshops, and exclusive events, all designed to help you transform your life and reach your fullest potential. It's a comprehensive platform for lifelong learning and personal development.

### Is it easy to cancel Mindvalley Membership?

Yes, canceling your [Mindvalley Membership](https://www.mindvalley.com/membership)
 is straightforward. You can easily manage your subscription directly from your account settings on the Mindvalley website. Simply log in, navigate to your "My Account" or "Billing" section, and follow the prompts to cancel your Mindvalley Membership. We aim to make the process as hassle-free as possible, ensuring you have full control over your subscription without any hidden hoops to jump through.

### Is Mindvalley Lifebook worth it?

Many people find [Mindvalley Lifebook](https://www.mindvalley.com/lifebook/online)
 to be a worthwhile investment for its comprehensive approach to life design. It guides you through a structured process to define your ideal life across 12 key areas, from career and finances to relationships and health. The program offers practical tools, inspiring insights, and a supportive community, helping participants create a detailed "Lifebook" that serves as a personalized blueprint for their future. If you're looking for a structured way to gain clarity, set meaningful goals, and take actionable steps towards a more fulfilling life, Mindvalley Lifebook can be very beneficial.

### Are Mindvalley courses effective?

Mindvalley courses are widely considered effective by many users, offering a diverse array of programs focused on personal growth, health, and spiritual development. Their effectiveness often stems from their unique blend of expert-led content, actionable exercises, and a supportive community. While individual results can vary based on commitment and personal goals, many [Mindvalley testimonials and reviews](https://stories.mindvalley.com/)
 highlight significant positive transformations. The platform's emphasis on holistic well-being and practical application helps users integrate learned concepts into their daily lives, contributing to the perceived effectiveness of Mindvalley courses.

### Does Mindvalley have free courses?

Yes, Mindvalley offers a selection of [free courses](https://www.mindvalley.com/free-courses)
 and resources. While the full Mindvalley experience, including access to their premium Quests and programs, requires a Mindvalley Membership, we frequently provide free masterclasses, introductory workshops, and guided meditations. These free offerings are a great way to explore Mindvalley's unique learning approach and experience the quality of their content before committing to a membership.

### Which Mindvalley program is the best?

The best Mindvalley program for you truly depends on your personal goals and interests. Mindvalley offers a diverse range of Quests covering areas like personal growth, health, relationships, career, and spirituality. To find your perfect fit, we recommend exploring the Mindvalley program library available after you complete your [mindvalley.com](http://mindvalley.com/)
 login. You'll find detailed descriptions and testimonials for each Quest, allowing you to choose the program that aligns best with what you want to achieve.

### Setze das Potential deines Verstandes

mit dem Silva Ultramind System frei

![Vishen bringt 500 Menschen Das Silva Ultramind System in Tallinn, Estland bei. ](https://storyblok-cdn.mindvalley.com/f/60579/480x718/9866dfe8f0/sums_sp_solution-d_2x.jpg?quality=60&auto=webp&dpr=1&width=500)

Vishen bringt 500 Menschen Das Silva Ultramind System in Tallinn, Estland bei.

Das Silva Ultramind System ist eine höchst optimierte Methode, um das gesamte Potential deines Verstandes zu erwecken.

Es basiert auf der Silva-Methode, einer bahnbrechenden Methode, mit der du deinen Verstand befähigst. Sie wurde 1960 von José Silva, einem texanischen Radio-Ingenieur, ins Leben gerufen und fand Anklang bei mehr als 6 Millionen Anhänger\*innen in über 110 Ländern.

Durch den leicht nachvollziehbaren Aufbau der Methode entwickelst du ein instinktives Verständnis für die vier primären Bewusstseinszustände des menschlichen Geistes und lernst, wie du diese nutzen kannst, um dich optimal zu entwickeln, zu handeln und dein bestes Leben zu führen:

1.  **DIE BETA-EBENE**  
    Dein normaler Bewusstseinszustand, wenn du wach und aufmerksam bist.
    

3.  **DIE ALPHA-EBENE**  
    Ein ruhiger und empfänglicher Zustand, der während Entspannungsphasen und leichtem Schlaf eintritt. Das ist der optimale Zustand, um zu lernen, zu wachsen und Selbstbewusstsein zu entwickeln.
    
4.  **DIE THETA-EBENE**  
    Der Zustand der Meditation und des Tiefschlafs. Dieser lässt Selbstreflexion, Selbsthypnose, Geist-Körper-Heilung und mehr zu.
    
5.  **DIE DELTA-EBENE**  
    Der tiefste Zustand des Unbewusstseins und des traumlosen Schlafes.
    

Nach Jahrzehnten gründlicher Fallstudien und Forschung konnte durch die Silva-Methode herausgefunden werden, dass die **Alpha-** und **Theta-Ebenen** unseres Bewusstseins die wichtigste Rolle in der Persönlichkeitsentwicklung eines Menschen spielen.

Diese Beobachtung wurde vielfach begutachtet und bestätigt, einschließlich von Studien zu indigenen Gemeinschaften, die das „mehrphasige” Verständnis von Bewusstsein nutzen, um verborgene Kräfte in durchschnittlichen Menschen zu erwecken.

Das Silva Ultramind System gibt dir Techniken an die Hand, mit deren Hilfe du beliebig auf diese Kräfte zugreifen kannst. Dein Leben zu verändern wird also dank dieser Techniken so einfach und natürlich von der Hand gehen wie ein gewöhnlicher Atemzug.

Der Kursaufbau
--------------

Wie die Quest Das Silva Ultramind System aufgebaut ist
------------------------------------------------------

Das Silva Ultramind System ist eine 28-tägige Online-Quest, die vom Mindvalley Gründer und Silva-Trainer Vishen Lakhiani geleitet wird. ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que aprendiste a leer?

Lo más seguro es que te lo estés preguntando en voz alta en tu cabeza.

Verás, hay una voz interna que surge cada vez que lees... y es tu voz.

Este es un hábito que la mayoría de las personas adquirió a la edad de seis años.

Cuando estabas en la primaria y tu maestro te hacía leer en voz alta, vocalizabas las palabras y él te indicaba si lo hacías bien o mal. A la larga, te pidieron que leyeras en silencio.

Fue entonces cuando interiorizaste esa voz en alto.

Esa también fue la última vez que aprendiste a leer.

Por ello, la mayoría de las mentes de las personas solo pueden leer y absorber información tan rápido como hablamos; lo que no solo desacelera dramáticamente no solo nuestra velocidad de lectura, también la de aprendizaje.

El programa "Superlectura" con Jim Kwik te guiará a través de un proceso rápido y comprobado para desaprender este hábito de lectura restrictivo, e instalará una habilidad de lectura nueva y optimizada que aumentará al doble tu velocidad de lectura. Y de paso, tu crecimiento personal.

El programa **Superlectura** es la metodología de lectura rápida altamente optimizada de Jim Kwik: el entrenador cerebral #1 que ya ha ayudado a maximizar el éxito de celebridades, profesionales destacados y artistas de alto rendimiento.

Lo que hace al programa **Superlectura** tan único es que aplica técnicas innovadoras de neuroestimulación y métodos comprobados de mejora de la memoria y lectura rápida.

Como resultado, los hemisferios izquierdo y derecho de tu cerebro se activan al mismo tiempo, lo que estimula a tu cerebro a retener más conocimiento con menos esfuerzo.

Comienzas a absorber nueva información a un ritmo asombroso, integras el conocimiento de forma más fluida sin pensar en cada palabra por separado.

**Aprendes, comprendes y retienes más en menos tiempo.**

Todo a través de un proceso sencillo que cualquier persona puede comenzar a usar en su día a día.

En solo 21 días, el programa Superlectura **duplicará** tu velocidad de lectura y aprendizaje. Te lo garantizamos.

Contenidos del Desafío
----------------------

### El Desafío Superlectura está diseñado para garantizar tu aprendizaje permanente con menos esfuerzo

El desafío _Super Lectura_ es un programa en línea de 21 días que activará tu potencial de lectura y aprendizaje acelerado.

Cada día, pasarás solo de 10 a 20 minutos con Jim Kwik, mientras te guía a través de sus técnicas de lectura rápida y neuroestimulación, y revertirás los métodos de lectura indeseables con los que has estado condicionado desde niño.

Algunos días, aprenderás estrategias para ayudar a tu cerebro a procesar información a lo que parece la velocidad de la luz. Otros días, viajarás a través de la expansión de la capacidad de tu mente para aprender nueva información al practicar las nuevas habilidades que has adquirido.

Al final del programa, Jim te garantiza que al menos duplicarás tu velocidad de lectura y aprendizaje, y estarás preparado para crecer y lograr el ritmo más rápido posible.

### Jim Kwik, creador de _Súper Lectura_

Jim Kwik (sí, su apellido de verdad es Kwik) es considerado uno de los principales expertos del mundo en aprendizaje acelerado, memoria, lectura rápida y rendimiento cerebral.

Durante las últimas dos décadas, Jim se ha desempeñado como entrenador mental de multimillonarios, celebridades, estudiantes, profesionales y directores ejecutivos de alto nivel que buscan mejorar su capacidad de procesamiento y productividad.

También es muy cotizado por varias organizaciones líderes en su ámbito, entre ellas Harvard, Nike, Virgin, Fox Studios, Singularity University, Zappos, SpaceX y más.

La curiosidad de Jim por la mente humana comenzó desde que era niño, después de que una lesión cerebral le provocara severas secuelas de aprendizaje. Esto lo inspiró a desarrollar una serie de técnicas que cualquier persona —sin importar su edad o nivel educativo— puede usar para aprovechar al máximo el potencial de su cerebro e impulsar el éxito en su vida.

Ahora Jim comparte sus enseñanzas frente a audiencias en vivo, en medios de comunicación y sesiones de entrenamiento privadas con grandes personalidades de todo el mundo.

A través del programa **Superlectura**, Jim busca compartir sus revolucionarios métodos de lectura rápida con un público aún más amplio y empoderar a las personas para que alcancen su máximo potencial a través del aprendizaje acelerado.

Conscious Uncoupling
====================

### Become a Mindvalley Member, and unlock access to Conscious Uncoupling + Mindvalley’s full curriculum of 100+ transformational programs for as low as $1 a day.

Get unlimited access to the world's best programs, and awaken greatness in every dimension of your life

[Join the program](https://www.mindvalley.com/conscious-uncoupling#join-the-program)

Have you ever found yourself wondering, “What went wrong in the relationship?”

Maybe you’ve been stuck trying to analyze every little detail that led to the breakup.

Maybe you’re still struggling with unbearable pain, guilt, or shame.

And maybe you have no clue how you’re ever going to live with yourself, let alone start a new relationship.

A breakup is one of the most traumatic experiences a person can have.

But according to marriage therapist and New York Times bestselling author Katherine Woodward Thomas: this is often because we haven’t been taught how to heal, reflect, and move on in the kindest and most productive way possible.

Katherine’s internationally acclaimed Conscious Uncoupling process has helped millions of people - including Hollywood celebrities - thrive through even the most bitter breakups.

And through her debut program with Mindvalley, you too can now harness a better way to both mend your heart and soul, and open yourself to love again.

### Introducing Conscious Uncoupling to Heal Your Heart, Reclaim Your Power, and Live Happily Even After

Conscious Uncoupling is a simple 5-step method to guide you through the process of getting through a breakup.

Whether you’re fresh off a breakup, on the verge of a breakup, or still struggling with past breakup wounds, Conscious Uncoupling will show you how to heal from the end of a relationship so you can move forward in peace.

**This step-by-step method empowers you — _with or without the cooperation and support of your former partner_ — to honor the love that was shared and move on, free to love and be loved again.**

No matter how challenging the circumstances are surrounding your breakup…

You will navigate the end of your relationship with grace, dignity and goodwill. And you’ll experience profound levels of healing and heart-repair.

The Curriculum
--------------

### Explore Conscious Uncoupling

The Conscious Uncoupling Quest is a simple 5-step process to finally heal the pain of your breakup. So often, we leave our healing to time… But time does not heal all wounds.

Conscious Uncoupling is designed to help you heal the wounds of your heart and finally free yourself from the pain, overwhelm, and grief of your breakup.

You’ll spend around 20 minutes per day unlocking powerful strategies and healing processes with Katherine Woodward Thomas.

As you unlock each day of Conscious Uncoupling through Mindvalley’s exclusive Quest learning platform, you’re experiencing healing on a profound and permanent level.

### Katherine Woodward Thomas on Healing from a Breakup

Katherine Woodward Thomas is a NY Times Best-Selling author, licensed therapist and teacher to thousands across the world.

When Katherine was in her early forties, she attracted and married a wonderful man named Mark. Together, they had her first child when Katherine was 43. But after ten wonderful years of marriage, Katherine and her husband found themselves wanting to part ways. They looked at their lives and wondered whether they still needed to be married, and if marriage was holding them back. Katherine had been through painful, excruciating breakups in her past relationships that took years of recovery… after one breakup she lost half the hair on her head and stopped eating for a year. Both she and Mark were also determined not to put their daughter through the pain of a hostile divorce situation like they’d experienced in their childhoods. So they made the decision to consciously uncouple and align on a shared intention to love & raise their daughter as loving co-parents.

It was through this experience that Katherine created Conscious Uncoupling. After seeing how well it worked in her own life, Katherine wrote her NY Times Best-Seller by the same name to help others end their relationships with honor, grace, and healing. Conscious Uncoupling has since become an international process of healing and love, even helping Hollywood actress Gwyneth Paltrow and Coldplay’s Chris Martin amicably end their marriage.

Vishen Lakhiani and Kristina Mand-Lakhiani also used this process to respectfully part ways, while remaining friends and co-parents. Now, it’s Katherine’s mission to guide others through her 5-step process to get over a breakup, make your heart whole, and move forward in happiness.

The following Privacy Policy governs the online information collection practices of Mindvalley Inc and its associated global entities (“Company,” "we" or "us"). It outlines the types of information that we gather about you while you are using [www.mindvalley.com](http://www.mindvalley.com/)
, [www.afest.com](http://www.afest.com/)
, [www.mylifebook.com](http://www.mylifebook.com/)
, [www.getworkway.com](http://www.getworkway.com/)
, [www.workway.app](http://www.workway.app/)
, [www.mindvalleystates.com](http://www.mindvalleystates.com/)
, and other websites operated by Company (collectively, the "Site"), and the ways in which we use this information. We, at Mindvalley, understand the importance of your privacy and are dedicated to securing your personal data. We process your data in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations following industry best practices.

The Privacy Policy applies primarily to information that we collect online; however, it may apply to some of the data that you provide to us offline and/or through other means as well (for example, at a live event, via telephone, or through the mail).

The Privacy Policy describes the manner in which our Company collects information from all end users of our Internet services (the “Services”), including those who access some of our Services but do not have accounts (“Visitors”), and those who may purchase products and/or pay a monthly service fee to subscribe to the Service (“Members”).

We may collect different data from or about you depending on how you use the Site.

Data you provide to us:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| Online registration | The Site only contacts individuals who specifically request the same or in the event that they have signed up to receive our messaging, attended one of our events, or have purchased one of our products. This information includes name, e-mail address for registration or opt-in purposes and name, postal address, and credit card information when registering for our events or purchasing our products. |
| Online purchasing | If you order Services or products directly from our Company, we will use the personal information you provide only to process that order. If you complete an order for some other company(ies) that may be linked to our Site, such as an online gift order sent directly to a recipient, you may be asked to provide information about the recipient, such as the recipient’s name, address, and phone number. Our company has no control over the third parties’ use of any personal information. |
| Signing up for our products or services | The personal information collected from Members during the signing up process (or at any other time) is used primarily to provide a customized experience while using our products and Services. Personal information collected includes name, address, telephone number, billing information (such as a credit card number), and the type of personal computer being used to access the Services. |
| Communications and support | If you contact us for support or to report a problem or concern (regardless of whether you have created an account), we collect and store your contact information, messages, and other data about you like your name, email address, messages, location, and any other data you provide or that we collect through automated means. |
| Data from third party sites | You are also given the option to link your Mindvalley account on the Site with your account on a third-party site such as, Facebook. If you have accessed our Site via a social media platform, such as Facebook, we may collect information related to your social media account. Personal information may include your first and last name, gender, location, username, e-mail address, picture or phone number. |
| Affiliate links | If you have signed up for or bought something from Mindvalley via an affiliate link, the person or organization in charge of the affiliate link will have the information that you submitted. This may include your email address, name, address, or whatever else that was asked. |
| Applying for a job | When you apply for a job opening through the Site, we collect information such as full name, email address, phone number, location, CV, and LinkedIn profile. |

Data we collect through automated means:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| System data | Technical data about your computer or device, like the IP address, device type, operating system type and version. This data helps us improve the delivery of our web pages and to measure traffic on the Site. |
| Lifebook IntraSpect Assessment (https://life.mindvalley.com) | Some personal information may be collected through the use of Lifebook IntraSpect Assessment. We gather data via this assessment in order for our users to raise awareness about themselves. However, we do use this data for marketing purposes as a recommendation tool.The data collected during the assessment may be used for profiling for direct marketing purposes. |

Some information is collected through the use of cookies, web beacons and tracking technologies. Please refer to the [“Cookie Policy”](https://www.mindvalley.com/cookie-policy)
 for more details on the type of cookies being used.

We may collect personal and sensitive personal information about you and store this information in connection with the provision and fulfilment of our Services to you. Personal information may include:

*   Name
*   Email Address
*   Mailing Address
*   Billing Address
*   PayPal Email Address
*   Masked Credit Card Information (for - refunds)
*   Age
*   Gender
*   Marital Status
*   Religion
*   Income Range
*   Education
*   Profession
*   Parent Status
*   Other responses to surveys and questionnaires
*   Sign-up source
*   Date of account creation
*   Date of account updates
*   IP address
*   Time stamp
*   Device type
*   Operating system

*   Browser
*   Email open clicks
*   User ID
*   User behaviour
*   Login history
*   Order details
*   Location
*   Facebook ID
*   Photo
*   Language
*   Country
*   Time zone
*   Birthday
*   NPS score
*   Your rating of our support
*   Telephone number
*   Telephone call recordings
*   Testimonials, with your authorization
*   Anonymized Facebook comments
*   Live location
*   Sexual preference

Mindvalley uses AI-driven technologies to personalize your experience, including content recommendations, interactive responses, and tailored course suggestions. AI-powered features like Eve may process certain data points (e.g., usage behavior, preferences, interactions) to enhance engagement and improve content delivery. AI-generated responses may not always be accurate, and we encourage users to verify critical information. The above personal information may be used for the following purposes:

*   To operate, improve, or promote our Service;
*   To contact you;
*   When you have opted to receive e-mails;
*   To respond to your email inquiries. Specifically, when Visitors or Members send email inquiries to us, the return email address is used to answer the email inquiry we receive. We do not use the return email address for any other purpose, or share it with third parties;
*   To monitor and analyse trends such as: purchase history, sales reports, behaviour on the site, email clicks and opens;
*   To market our products and Services through: email marketing, advertising, including retargeting via Google and Facebook notifications;
*   Perform accounting, administrative and legal tasks; For profiling or auto matching user preferences for better & efficient user experience.

Who has access to your data within our organization
===================================================

Within our Organization, access to your data is limited to those persons who require access in order to provide you with the products and Services, which you purchase from us, to contact you, and to respond to your inquiries, including requests for refund. Those staff members may be on teams such as: marketing, events, development, executive, customer support. Employees only have access to data that is relevant to their team, on a “need to know” basis.

Who we share your data with outside of our organization, and why
================================================================

Processors
==========

We may use service providers for operating and improving the Site, to assist with certain functions, such as payment processing, email transmission, conducting surveys or contests, data hosting, managing our ads, third-party solutions for marketing and analytics, and some aspects of our technical and customer support. We take measures to ensure that these service providers access, process, and store information about you only for the purposes we authorize, through the execution of Data Processing Agreements or Addenda.

Authorities
===========

We may access, preserve, and disclose information about you to third parties, including the content of messages, if we believe disclosure is in accordance with, or required by, applicable law, regulation, legal process, or audits. We may also disclose information about you if we believe that your actions are inconsistent with our Terms and Conditions or related guidelines and policies, or if necessary to protect the rights, property, or safety of, or prevent fraud or abuse of, Company or others.

Transfer of business
====================

If we (or our assets) are acquired, or if we go out of business, enter bankruptcy, or go through some other change of control, personal information could be one of the assets transferred to or acquired by a third party.

Why and for how long do we store information we collect from you
================================================================

We retain certain information collected from you while you are a member on the Site, and in certain cases where you have deleted your account, for the following reasons:

*   So that you can use our Site;
*   To ensure that we do not communicate with you if you have asked us not to;
*   To provide you with a refund, if entitled;
*   To better understand the traffic to our Site so that we can provide all members with the best possible experience;
*   To detect and prevent abuse of our Site, illegal activities and breaches of our Terms and Conditions; and
*   To comply with applicable legal, tax or accounting requirements.

We retain user data for as long as necessary for the purposes described above. This means that we retain different categories of data for different periods of time depending on the type of data, the category of user to whom the data relates to, and the purposes for which we collected the data.

Advertiser Disclosures
======================

Google Analytics
================

We use Google Analytics Advertiser Features to optimize our business. Advertiser features include:

*   Remarketing with Google Analytics
*   Google Display Network Impression Reporting
*   Double Click Platform integrations
*   Google Analytics Demographics and Interest Reporting

Among other uses, this allows us to contact you if you begin to fill out our check-out form but abandon it before completion with an email reminding you to complete your order. The “Remarketing” feature allows us to reach people who previously visited our Site, and match the right audience with the right advertising message.

Facebook
========

As advertisers on Facebook and through our Facebook page, we, (not Facebook) may collect content or information from a Facebook user and such information may be used in the same manner specified in this Privacy Policy.

Security
========

We implement a variety of administrative, managerial, and technical security measures to help protect your personal information. Our Company has various internal control standards which relate specifically to the handling of personal information. These include certain controls to help safeguard the information we collect online. Our employees are trained to understand and comply with these controls and we communicate our Privacy Policy, practices and guidelines to our employees. However, while we strive to protect your personal information, you must also take steps to protect your information. We urge you to take every precaution to protect your personal information while you are on the Internet.

Your rights under the GDPR
==========================

You have certain rights if you are within the EU this includes:

*   **Right to access.** This right allows you to obtain a copy of your personal data, as well as other supplementary information.
*   **Right to restrict processing.** You have the right to restrict the processing of your personal data in certain circumstances.
*   **Right to rectification.** You have the right to have any incomplete or inaccurate information we hold about you corrected.
*   **Right to object to processing.** The right to object allows you to stop or prevent us from processing your personal data. This right exists where we are relying on a legitimate interest as the legal basis for processing your Personal Data. You also have the right to object where we are processing your Personal data for direct marketing purposes and profiling purposes.
*   **Right to erasure.** You have the right to ask us to delete or remove Personal data when the personal data is no longer necessary for the purpose which you originally collected or processed.
*   **Right to data portability.** You have the right to receive your personal data that you have provided to Mindvalley, in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.

To exercise your rights, you can contact Mindvalley’s Data Protection Officer by email at [GDPR@mindvalley.com](mailto:GDPR@mindvalley.com)
. If you reside outside of the European Economic Area and Switzerland, contact 97005-2343 or email [privacy@mindvalley.com](mailto:privacy@mindvalley.com)
. To know more about your rights and how to exercise them visit our Data Subject Request Policy.

You can disable AI-based personalization within your account settings or contact us at [GDPR@mindvalley.com](mailto:GDPR@mindvalley.com)
. If you choose to opt-out, Mindvalley will no longer use AI to tailor content recommendations or interactive responses, though standard personalization features may still apply. Note that opting out may limit the effectiveness of some features.

Your rights under the CCPA
==========================

This Policy reflects our compliance with the California Consumer Privacy Act.

The following table sets forth the categories of personal information we have collected in the preceding 12 months, the source of that personal information, and how we have used and shared such personal information for business purposes in the preceding 12 months.

| Category of Personal Information Collected | Source of Information | Purpose for Collection | Categories of Recipients |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Identifiers: your name, postal address, email address, Paypal email address, telephone numbers, or other similar identifiers | From you or from our website or app technology’s interaction with your browser or devices and cookies tracking the pages you visit. | Please refer to the section “How We Use Your Personal Information” in Mindvalley’s Privacy Policy. | Mindvalley’s service providers and third party vendors. |
| Payment Information: name, masked credit card information(for refunds), billing address, records of payment | From you or from our website or app technology’s interaction with your browser or devices and cookies tracking the pages you visit. | Please refer to the section “How We Use Your Personal Information” in Mindvalley’s Privacy Policy. | Mindvalley’s service providers and third party vendors. |
| Characteristics of Protected Classifications under State or Federal Law: Age, Gender, Marital Status, Religion, Parent Status | From you or from our website or app technology’s interaction with your browser or devices and cookies tracking the pages you visit. | Please refer to the section “How We Use Your Personal Information” in Mindvalley’s Privacy Policy. | Mindvalley’s service providers and third party vendors. |
| Professional and Employment Information | From you or from our website or app technology’s interaction with your browser or devices and cookies tracking the pages you visit. | Please refer to the section “How We Use Your Personal Information” in Mindvalley’s Privacy Policy. | Mindvalley’s service providers and third party vendors. |
| Voluntary Information: any voluntary information you provide to us, such as responses to surveys and social media account details, including income range, preferences, goals, and other personal information released in surveys or communications | From you or from our website or app technology’s interaction with your browser or devices and cookies tracking the pages you visit. | Please refer to the section “How We Use Your Personal Information” in Mindvalley’s Privacy Policy. | Mindvalley’s service providers and third party vendors. |
| Personalization: inferences drawn from your interactions online, how you use our site and app to create a profile reflecting your preferences, characteristics, interests, and behavior | From you or from our website or app technology’s interaction with your browser or devices and cookies tracking the pages you visit. | Please refer to the section “How We Use Your Personal Information” in Mindvalley’s Privacy Policy. | Mindvalley’s service providers and third party vendors. |
| Internet or other electronic network activity information: IP address, geolocation data, internet provider, operating system and browser used, type of device, search history, device cookie setting, and other device details | From you or from our website or app technology’s interaction with your browser or devices and cookies tracking the pages you visit. | Please refer to the section “How We Use Your Personal Information” in Mindvalley’s Privacy Policy. | Mindvalley’s service providers and third party vendors. |

The rights Users have as California residents under the California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) include:

*   **Right to know.** You have the right to request to know more about the personal information we have collected, including the categories of personal information and the specific pieces of personal information, the categories of sources from which the person information is collected, the business or commercial purpose for collecting, and the categories of third parties to whom we have disclosed personal information.
*   **Right to deletion.** You have the right to request deletion of personal information that we have collected about you.
*   **Right to opt-out.** You have the right to opt out of the sale of your personal information. We do not sell personal information. However, the service providers we partner with (for example, our advertising partners) may use technology on the Service that "sells" personal information as defined by the CCPA. If you wish to opt out of the use of your personal information for interest-based advertising purposes and these potential sales as defined under CCPA law, you may do so by following the instructions below. Please note that any opt out is specific to the browser you use. You may need to opt out on every browser that you use.

Website:

You can opt out of receiving ads that are personalized as served by our service providers by following our instructions presented on the Service:

    - From Our "Cookie Consent" notice banner
    - Or from Our "CCPA Opt-out" notice banner
    - Or from Our "Do Not Sell My Personal Information" notice banner
    - Or from Our "Do Not Sell My Personal Information" link
    

Mobile Devices:

Your mobile device may give you the ability to opt out of the use of information about the apps you use in order to serve you ads that are targeted to your interests:

    - "Opt out of Interest-Based Ads" or "Opt out of Ads Personalization" on Android devices
    - "Limit Ad Tracking" on iOS devices
    

*   **Right to correct.** You have the right to correct inaccurate Personal Information we collected about you.

To exercise any of these rights under CCPA, please email [ccpa@mindvalley.com](mailto:ccpa@mindvalley.com)
 or reach out to Customer Service per [www.mindvalley.com](http://www.mindvalley.com/)
. To know more about your rights and how to exercise them, visit our Data Subject Request Policy. Please allow up to 45 days for us to process your request. You may submit such a request once per year.

**Non-discrimination.** You have the right to not receive discriminatory treatment for the exercise of privacy rights under the CCPA.

You can disable AI-based personalization within your account settings or contact us at [GDPR@mindvalley.com](mailto:GDPR@mindvalley.com)
. If you choose to opt-out, Mindvalley will no longer use AI to tailor content recommendations or interactive responses, though standard personalization features may still apply. Note that opting out may limit the effectiveness of some features.

##### “Do Not Track" Policy as required by California Online Privacy Protection Act (CalOPPA)

Our Site does not respond to Do Not Track signals. However, some third-party websites do keep track of your browsing activities. If you are visiting such websites, you can set your preferences in your web browser to inform websites that you do not want to be tracked. You can enable or disable DNT by visiting the preferences or settings page of your web browser.

##### Our policy concerning children

This children's privacy statement explains our practices with respect to the online collection and usage of personal information from children under the age of thirteen, and provides important information regarding their rights under federal law with respect to such information.

This Site is not directed to children under the age of thirteen and we do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under the age of thirteen knowingly distribute such information to third parties. We screen users who wish to provide personal information in order to prevent users under the age of thirteen from providing such information. If we become aware that we have inadvertently received personally identifiable information from a user under the age of thirteen as part of the Site, we will delete such information from our records. If we change our practices in the future, we will obtain prior, verifiable parental consent before collecting any personally identifiable information from children under the age of thirteen as part of the Site.

##### California Privacy Rights for Minor Users (California Business and Professions Code Section 22581)

California Business and Professions Code Section 22581 allows California residents under the age of 18, who are registered users of online sites, services or applications, to request and obtain removal of content or information they have publicly posted.

To request removal of such data, and if you are a California resident, you can contact us using the contact information provided below and include the email address associated with your account.

Be aware that your request does not guarantee complete or comprehensive removal of content or information posted online and that the law may not permit or require removal in certain circumstances.

##### Links to other websites

Our Site may contain links to other websites that are not operated by us. If you click on a third-party link, you will be directed to that third party's site. We strongly advise you to review the Privacy Policy of every site you visit.

##### Changes to this Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page. If we make any material change/s to the Policy, we will endeavor to provide appropriate notice, or as required by applicable law. You can see when the Policy was last updated by checking the date at the bottom of this page. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes to this Privacy Policy are effective from when they are posted on this page.

##### Contact us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact our Data Protection Officer at: [GDPR@mindvalley.com](mailto:GDPR@mindvalley.com)
 or [privacy@mindvalley.com](mailto:privacy@mindvalley.com)
 or you can visit this page on our website: [https://www.mindvalley.com/privacy-policy](https://www.mindvalley.com/privacy-policy)
.

Last Updated: 23 June, 2023
